news.body: The Baltimore Ravens D/ST was run over by the Jaguars on Thursday, allowing 33 points in the 23-point loss. They did manage a fumble recovery, but that was the only real counting stat they managed.
news.head: Baltimore Ravens D/ST struggle against Jacksonville
news.impact: It was a rough showing by the Ravens' unit, but they weren't helped by the offense, which often gave the Jaguars short fields to work with, putting more pressure on the defense. They will look to get things back on track against the Chargers.

news.body: The Ravens D/ST allowed 289 passing yards, 146 rushing yards, and 36 points in a loss to the Bills.
news.head: Ravens D/ST allows 36 points in Week 8 loss
news.impact: The Ravens' defense tallied one sack, one interception, and one fumble recovery in the loss. They made a few key stops in the red zone as well, but the Ravens' offense could not find a way to get anything going. They will take on the Jaguars in Week 9.

news.body: The Ravens D/ST allowed 292 passing yards, 73 rushing yards, and 35 points in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals.
news.head: Ravens D/ST allows 35 second half points in Week 7 loss
news.impact: The Ravens' defense tallied one sack but failed to force a turnover in a loss to the Bengals. The Ravens' defense will face a tough matchup with Josh Allen and the Bills on the schedule for Week 8.

news.body: The Ravens D/ST surrendered only one touchdown while allowing 367 yards of offense in Sunday's 30-23 OT win against the Falcons.
news.head: Ravens defense come up with three sacks, one pick Sunday night
news.impact: The Falcons had a defensive score in Sunday night's contest, so the Ravens defense actually gave up fewer than 20 points in the overtime victory. The unit ended the game with a clutch interception and recorded three sacks over the course of the contest. The Ravens should be a popular play against the Browns in Week 6.

news.body: The Bills' defense gave up only six points on 178 yards of total offense, coming up with two sacks and three takeaways in Monday night's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Bills D/ST shuts down Vikings on Monday night
news.impact: This performance was probably more revealing of the Vikings' offensive ineptitude than the Bills' defensive dominance, but the latter reaped the benefits nonetheless. The Bills' defense has had the good fortune of matching up against a pair of beaten-down offenses over the past two weeks and has taken full advantage. The unit could remain a sneaky fantasy play with contests against the Jets and Dolphins coming up.

news.body: The Bills D/ST allowed 91 passing yards, 76 rushing yards, and 10 points in a win over the Ravens.
news.head: Bills D/ST allows 10 points in Week 8 win
news.impact: The Bills' defense tallied four sacks, one interception, and two fumble recoveries in the win over the Ravens. The Bills' defense benefited from the Ravens losing Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley to injury. Buffalo will take on the Vikings in Week 9.

news.body: The Bills' D/ST logged one interception and allowed 30 points in Sunday's win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Bills D/ST dismal in win Sunday
news.impact: Buffalo's defense looked terrible again in Week 6. They allowed Las Vegas to score 30 points over the course of the game, and they weren't able to log a single sack or turnover beyond one interception to help out their offense. This unit has been very bad to start the year and should not be started in any matchups for the foreseeable future.

news.body: The Bills D/ST allowed 34 points while picking up one sack in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5's Monday night game.
news.head: Bills D/ST allows 34 points in OT win in Week 5
news.impact: Buffalo's defense struggled to slow the Rams in the game, although they toughened up in overtime, holding LA scoreless. The Bills will look for a better fantasy performance in Week 6 vs. the Raiders.

news.body: The Packers D/ST recorded four sacks while also forcing four turnovers (three interceptions, one fumble recovery) in a 45-27 win over the Patriots in Week 9.
news.head: Packers D/ST disruptive in Week 9
news.impact: The defense took advantage of an overmatched New England offensive line, allowing less than 100 rushing yards in a winning effort. The unit will look for another disruptive performance against the Minnesota Vikings in Week 10.

news.body: The Packers D/ST held the Panthers to 19 points on 258 yards of total offense, recording six sacks and forcing two turnovers in Thursday's 27-19 win.
news.head: Packers defense racks up six sacks in Week 8 win
news.impact: The Packers have now won 4-of-5 games, giving up 20 or fewer points in all five weeks. The Green Bay defense has registered 15 sacks during that span, with six of them coming Thursday night. This is a unit still missing premier pass rusher Micah Parsons (knee), who is expected to return to practice in Week 9.

news.body: The Packers' D/ST logged two fumble recoveries and one sack while allowing 20 points in Sunday's loss to the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Packers D/ST forces two turnovers Sunday
news.impact: Green Bay's defense played pretty well on Sunday. They slowed down Detroit's elite offense and limited them to just 20 points on the day, and they were also able to log some big plays to help out their own offense. This unit has a short week coming up, with a matchup against the Panthers happening on Thursday night football in Week 8.

news.body: The Packers D/ST allowed 13 points while notching two interceptions and one sack in a 23-13 win over the Cowboys in Week 6.
news.head: Packers D/ST picks up two interceptions in Week 6
news.impact: Green Bay's defense was solid in the win, holding Dallas scoreless in the first half. They got interceptions from Evan Williams and Brandon Cisse while Lukas Van Ness provided the sack. The Packers will take on the Lions in Week 7.

news.body: The Texans' D/ST logged eight sacks, one interception, and one fumble recovery while allowing 22 points in Sunday's win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Texans D/ST fantastic in win Sunday
news.impact: Houston's defense came to play on Sunday. They were able to make a number of big plays that led to a blowout win over the Chargers, though they allowed some points in garbage time. This unit should continue to be started in the favorable matchups they have over the next couple of weeks.

news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 27 points on 420 total yards with three sacks on Sunday.
news.head: Texans D/ST struggles Sunday
news.impact: The Texans defense is not a must roster heading into their bye week.

news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 306 passing yards, 106 rushing yards, and 31 points in a win over Jacksonville.
news.head: Texans D/ST allows 31 points in Week 6 win
news.impact: The Texans' defense forced one interception, but tallied no sacks against Trevor Lawrence and the Jaguars. The Texans will take on the Giants in Week 7.

news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 3 points on 187 total yards with one interception, one fumble recovery and four sacks on Sunday against the Titans.
news.head: Texans D/ST dominates Sunday
news.impact: The Texans defense looked at their best of the season on Sunday. They'll take on Trevor Lawrence and Jacksonville next week.

news.body: The Jacksonville Jaguars D/ST had a sack, a fumble recovery and two interceptions in the Jags' 33-10 win over the Ravens on Thursday.
news.head: Jacksonville Jaguars handle Ravens in TNF win
news.impact: The Jags' defense dominated in this game, granted it didn't hurt that they were facing a third-string quarterback making his first NFL start on a short week. They held the Ravens to a measly 55 passing yards (counting sacks), and routinely messed up the Baltimore run game. They face off next against Tennessee.

news.body: The Jaguars D/ST gave up just seven points on 243 yards of offense, registering four sacks, one fumble recovery, and two interceptions in Sunday's 42-7 rout of the Colts.
news.head: Jaguars defense dominates in Week 8 blowout
news.impact: The Jaguars' defense scored off one of its interceptions in this one, as safety Rayuan Lane ran one back 92 yards to give the Jaguars a four-score lead going into halftime. This was a bounce-back performance for the Jaguars' defense, as the unit entered its Week 7 bye after a poor showing against the Texans. Jacksonville has now given up 17 or fewer points in five of seven games this season, and will take on a Ravens team facing a QB quandary on Thursday night. The Jaguars will be a popular play in Week 9.

news.body: The Jaguars D/ST allowed 312 passing yards, 114 rushing yards, and 34 points in a loss to Houston.
news.head: Jaguars D/ST allows 34 points in Week 6 loss
news.impact: The Jaguars' defense tallied one interception, but failed to record a sack. The defense has been solid all season and will look to regroup in their bye week before taking on the Colts in Week 8.

news.body: The Jaguars defense allowed only 17 points on 232 yards of offense, coming up with one sack in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
news.head: Jaguars D/ST allows just 17 points to depleted Eagles
news.impact: The Jaguars defense is one of the best in the league at shutting down the run. The unit lived up to that billing in Week 5, limiting the Eagles to only 22 yards on 18 rushing attempts. The Jaguars were also pretty solid against the pass, giving up 220 yards on 40 passes, 62 of which came on one big play. The Jaguars were facing a beaten-up Eagles offense, but it was still a strong effort. The Jaguars are allowing only 14.0 points per game and have yet to give up more than 20 in any of the first five weeks of the season.

news.body: The Chiefs D/ST allowed 165 passing yards, 106 rushing yards, and 12 points in a 35-12 win over the Jets.
news.head: Chiefs D/ST allows 12 points in Week 9
news.impact: The Chiefs' defense tallied 5 sacks and one fumble recovery in the win over the Jets. They will take on a struggling Falcons' offense in Week 10.

news.body: The Chiefs' defense allowed 28 points and 294 total yards. while recording one sack in Kansas City's Week 8 loss to the Broncos.
news.head: Chiefs D/ST fails to force turnover in Week 8
news.impact: Kansas City held Denver to 294 yards, but the defense failed to force a turnover and allowed 15 points in the fourth quarter. Jonah Coleman scored the game-winning touchdown with two minutes remaining. One sack and zero takeaways resulted in a poor fantasy day for the Chiefs D/ST.

news.body: The Chiefs D/ST allowed 20 points while forcing one turnover in a 20-3 loss to the Seahawks in Week 7.
news.head: Chiefs D/ST forces one turnover in Week 7 loss
news.impact: The Chiefs struggled on offense but their defense turned in a solid effort, limiting the Seahawks to two touchdowns. They managed to intercept Sam Darnold once in the contest. Kansas City will look to bounce back against the Broncos in Week 8.

news.body: The Kansas City Chiefs' defense allowed six points while recording four sacks and an interception in a 22-6 win over the Chargers in Week 6.
news.head: Chiefs D/ST Dominates Chargers in Week 6
news.impact: Kansas City kept Los Angeles out of the end zone and limited Justin Herbert to 204 passing yards while sacking him four times. The Chargers also went 0 for 3 on fourth down. Kansas City's defense continues to give fantasy managers a combination of scoring prevention and turnover upside and remains a strong starting option heading into next week.

news.body: The Los Angeles Rams D/ST held the Commanders to 13 points on Sunday and recovered a fumble. They also sacked Jayden Daniels four times.
news.head: Los Angeles Rams defense holds Commanders to 13 points in win
news.impact: After a stint on IR, Myles Garrett re-joined the Rams in the victory. With Garrett's return, the Rams will be a high-end D/ST option for Week 10's game against the Cardinals.

news.body: The Rams' D/ST logged two interceptions and two sacks while allowing just nine points in Sunday's 24-9 win over the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Rams D/ST plays well in win Sunday
news.impact: The Rams' defense had a good showing on Sunday. They were able to hold the Chargers to just nine points over the course of the game, while logging several big plays to help out their own offense. This unit has an easy schedule coming up with matchups against the Commanders and Cardinals over the next couple of weeks.

news.body: The Rams D/ST recorded two sacks while failing to force any turnovers in a 35-21 win over the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 7.
news.head: Rams D/ST stands tall in Week 7
news.impact: The defense was able to make stops when it counted, holding the Raiders to less than 50 rushing yards in the win. The unit will look to take advantage of an underperforming Los Angeles Chargers offense in Week 8.

news.body: The Rams' D/ST logged one interception and allowed 18 points in Sunday's loss to the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Rams D/ST allows 18 points in loss Sunday
news.impact: Los Angeles' defense wasn't good on Sunday. They held Arizona's offense to just 18 points, but they were held to just one forced turnover and didn't log even a single sack over the course of the game, which didn't help their own offense. This unit has an easier schedule over the next couple of weeks, but it will still be hard to trust starting them from a fantasy perspective.

news.body: The Vikings' defense gave up 23 points on 339 yards of total offense, registering four sacks and forcing one turnover in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Vikings D/ST picks up four sacks in Week 9 loss
news.impact: The Vikings' defense got pretty much no help from the offense in this one, but the unit hung tough regardless. The Vikings head into Week 10 tied for the league lead in sacks (29) and ranked second in yards allowed per game (280.0). Minnesota also ranks first in points allowed per game at 14.5.

news.body: The Vikings D/ST recorded four sacks while also forcing one turnover in a 19-15 loss to the Lions in Week 8.
news.head: Vikings D/ST does its part in Week 8
news.impact: The defense was unable to contain a physical Detroit ground attack, allowing 230 rushing yards and 5.9 yards per carry in the loss. The unit faces another stiff test against a physical Buffalo Bills offense in Week 9.

news.body: The Vikings defense allowed 10 points on 218 total yards with four sacks and one interception.
news.head: Vikings D/ST continues to dominate Sunday
news.impact: Outside of an early Jonathan Taylor touchdown, Minnesota remained shut down defensively all afternoon. The Vikings will draw the Lions next week.

news.body: The Vikings D/ST recorded one sack while also forcing two turnovers (two interceptions) in a 23-13 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 5.
news.head: Vikings D/ST stifling in Week 5 win
news.impact: The defense bottled up an underwhelming New Orleans offense, allowing just 142 offensive yards in the winning effort. The unit continues to offer fantasy managers an impactful option in D/ST formats with a Week 6 bye up next.

news.body: The Patriots' D/ST logged three sacks while allowing 45 points in Sunday's loss to the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Patriots D/ST allows 45 points in loss Sunday
news.impact: New England's defense had a terrible showing on Sunday. They allowed Green Bay to score 45 points over the course of the afternoon, despite the Packers losing their starting running back early on. This unit should not be started in a tough matchup against the Lions next week.

news.body: The New England Patriots D/ST racked up five sacks and a pick in the Patriots' 24-19 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
news.head: New England Patriots D/ST rack up five sacks in win
news.impact: The Patriots' defense struggled a bit in the first half before tightening up on the Dolphins in the second half, holding them to just six points while the offense got back on their feet. They will face a tougher matchup next week against Green Bay.

news.body: The Patriots' defense gave up 30 points and more than 400 yards of total offense in Thursday's 30-24 loss to the Bears.
news.head: Patriots D/ST records three sacks, gives up 30 points in Week 7 loss
news.impact: The Patriots did come up with three sacks on Bears QB Caleb Williams, but that was about the extent of the positives in Thursday's loss. The Patriots defense was coming off a couple of solid showings against the Raiders and Jets, but the Bears' high-powered offense in Chicago proved to be too much to handle for most of the night. Still, the Dolphins await in Week 8, which will make the Patriots unit a popular choice for fantasy managers.

news.body: The Patriots D/ST allowed 252 passing yards, 97 rushing yards, and 19 points in a win over the Jets.
news.head: Patriots D/ST solid in Week 6
news.impact: The Patriots' defense tallied three sacks and forced the first interception of the season for Geno Smith. The Patriots' defense will take on a high-powered Bears' offense in Week 7.

news.body: The Giants D/ST allowed 24 points while notching one sack and forcing two turnovers in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10.
news.head: Giants D/ST allows 24 points in TNF loss
news.impact: New York's defense struggled to contain the Commanders' passing attack as they allowed two long touchdown catches in the game. They did manage to intercept Jayden Daniels twice in the contest while getting a sack from Shelby Harris. The Giants will have a tough test in Week 11 against an excellent Jacksonville offense.

news.body: The Giants' D/ST logged seven sacks and one fumble recovery while allowing just 11 points in Sunday's win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Giants D/ST stellar in win Sunday
news.impact: New York's defense stepped up to the plate on Sunday. They held Philadelphia's offense to just 11 points over the course of the afternoon, and they were also able to log a number of big plays to help out their own offense. This unit should not be started outside of great matchups moving forward, however.

news.body: The Giants D/ST allowed 21 points on 237 total yards with one sack on Sunday against the Texans.
news.head: Giants D/ST holds their own Sunday
news.impact: The Giants were unable to force any turnovers. They remain off the fantasy radar.

news.body: The Giants defense allowed 34 points on 319 total yards with a fumble recovery on Sunday against the Saints.
news.head: Giants D/ST recovers fumble Sunday
news.impact: The Giants were unable to record any sacks on the day. They'll face CJ Stroud and the Texans next week.

news.body: The Steelers defense allowed six points on 319 total yards with eight sacks and two fumble recoveries on Sunday against the Browns.
news.head: Steelers D/ST racks up eight sacks Sunday
news.impact: The Steelers pass rush made it tough on Deshaun Watson all afternoon with eight sacks. The lone struggle for Pittsburgh on the day came via containing Harold Fannin. The Steelers head into their bye next week.

news.body: The Pittsburgh Steelers D/ST had a pick and two sacks in the team's 16-10 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: Pittsburgh Steelers D/ST limits Saints in win
news.impact: The Steelers kept the Saints offense out of the endzone and forced several more punts in the team's win to put them up at 5-2. It might not have been the prettiest game, but the defense certainly won't care. They will face the Browns at home next Sunday.

news.body: The Steelers D/ST allowed 19 points on 224 yards with two interceptions and five sacks on Sunday against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Steelers D/ST logs two interceptions Sunday
news.impact: The Steelers defense made it tough on rookie QB Jalon Daniels all afternoon in the overtime win. They'll face Tyler Shough and the Saints next week.

news.body: The Pittsburgh Steelers D/ST operated on a "bend, don't break" basis in the team's 34-22 win against the Colts on Sunday. They managed only a single sack and no turnovers against the Colts, but it was enough.
news.head: Pittsburgh Steelers D/ST contains Indy offense in win
news.impact: The Steelers didn't get much in terms of counting stats, but they kept the Colts out of the end zone and forced them to take a multitude of field goals. In every other game so far, they've generated at least two turnovers, helping boost their overall fantasy scoring, but that wasn't the case for them today. They're not an incredible option at defense, but they're a usable streaming option.

news.body: The Seahawks defense allowed three points on 198 total yards with three sacks.
news.head: Seahawks D/ST dominates Sunday
news.impact: The Seahawks were able to completely shut down the entire Cardinals offense all afternoon. They'll face Kirk Cousins and the Raiders on the road next week.

news.body: The Seahawks' D/ST logged just one sack and one fumble recovery while allowing 34 points in Monday night's loss the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Seahawks D/ST struggles in loss Monday
news.impact: Seattle normally has a very stout defense, but they got outclassed by Chicago on Monday night. They ended up giving up 34 points over the course of the night, which led to yet another loss for the Seahawks. This unit will have a great opportunity to bounce back in a matchup against the Cardinals next week, however.

news.body: The Seahawks D/ST allowed three points while notching one sack and forcing one turnover in a 20-3 win over the Chiefs in Week 7.
news.head: Seahawks D/ST dominates Chiefs in Week 7
news.impact: Seattle's defense came to play in the impressive win over the previously undefeated Chiefs. The Seahawks intercepted Patrick Mahomes once in the contest. They will have another tough test ahead of them in Week 8 vs. the Bears.

news.body: The Seattle Seahawks D/ST managed two sacks in the team's 17-14 loss to Denver.
news.head: Seattle Seahawks D/ST stifles Denver despite loss
news.impact: They didn't put much else up on the box score, but they largely played a good game, with both of the Broncos' touchdown drives coming in the second quarter, and largely being shut down besides that. They'll have better fantasy performances in the coming weeks.

news.body: The Commanders D/ST allowed 21 points while notching one sack and forcing two turnovers in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.
news.head: Commanders D/ST allows 21 points in TNF win
news.impact: Washington's defense struggled to contain Cam Skattebo, who ran for two touchdowns, but they otherwise did a decent job limiting the Giants. They will have a much tougher test on their hands in Week 11 when they face off against a red-hot Bengals offense.

news.body: The Washington Commanders D/ST allowed 20 points in Sunday's loss to the Rams. The unit also recorded one interception and one sack.
news.head: Washington Commanders D/ST give up 20 points in loss
news.impact: The Commanders defense has been volatile and unreliable in the 2026 campaign. However, they look to be a viable streamer for Week 10's rematch with the Giants on Thursday Night Football.

news.body: The Commanders D/ST allowed 10 points while picking up five sacks and forcing two turnovers in a 27-10 win over the Eagles in Week 8.
news.head: Washington D/ST allows 10 points in Week 8 win
news.impact: Washington's defense made life miserable for Eagles QB Tanner McKee. The Commanders held the Eagles to just 268 yards of total offense on Sunday night. They will look to stay hot against the Rams in Week 9.

news.body: The Commanders D/ST allowed 23 points while notching two sacks and recovering a fumble in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6's Monday night game.
news.head: Commanders D/ST picks up two sacks in Week 6
news.impact: Washington's defense allowed 20 points in the first half but held the 49ers to just a field goal after halftime. They recovered a Christian McCaffrey fumble while getting sacks from Shy Tuttle and Odafe Oweh. Washington will be on bye in Week 7 before they face the Eagles in Week 8.

news.body: Brandon Aubrey made two of his three field-goal attempts and added three extra points in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey makes two FGs in Week 9
news.impact: Aubrey drilled field goals from 45 and 28 yards out in the close win over Indy. The veteran kicker has now made 17 of his 22 field-goal attempts and 23 extra points this year. He will take on the 49ers in Week 10.

news.body: Brandon Aubrey converted all three extra point attempts as well as three of his four field goal attempts to finish with 12 points in the Cowboys' 33-30 loss to the Cardinals in Week 8.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey misses field goal in Week 8
news.impact: Aubrey has been impactful of late, recording 10 or more points in five of his last seven contests. The kicker will look to offer another explosive performance in a favorable Week 9 contest against the Indianapolis Colts.

news.body: Brandon Aubrey went 3-for-3 on his field-goal attempts and 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts in Monday night's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey scores 12 points in win Monday
news.impact: Aubrey had a perfect showing on Monday night, making all six of his kicks in a win over the Eagles. He is one of the NFL's best kickers and should continue to produce like it moving forward.

news.body: Brandon Aubrey did not attempt a field goal while hitting his lone extra point in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey held to one XP in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Aubrey was held without a field-goal attempt for the second time this season as Dallas really struggled to move the ball on offense against Green Bay, especially in the first half. Aubrey has now hit nine of his 12 field goals and added 14 extra points this season. He will look to bounce back against the Eagles in Week 7.

news.body: Brandon McManus made two field goals and two extra points in Sunday's game against the Commanders.
news.head: Brandon McManus hits all four kicks in win
news.impact: McManus has been perfect in the three games he's played for the Rams. He will look to continue that streak against the Cardinals in Week 10.

news.body: Brandon McManus went 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts and made his lone field-goal attempt in Sunday's 24-9 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Brandon McManus perfect in win Sunday
news.impact: The veteran did his job on Sunday, making all four of his attempted kicks in a win over the Chargers. Fantasy managers should expect him to continue to have a decent floor moving forward.

news.body: Brandon McManus converted each of his five extra point attempts in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 7.
news.head: Brandon McManus perfect in Week 7
news.impact: McManus offered head coach Sean McVay a reliable kicking option for the first time this season and will look for another impactful performance in a Week 8 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers.

news.body: The Rams signed kicker Brandon McManus.
news.head: Brandon McManus signs with Rams
news.impact: McManus lands a deal following a workout on Monday.

news.body: Cam Little hit all four of his field goal attempts and all three PATs in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Cam Little racks up 15 kicking points in win
news.impact: Little now has totals of 10, 7, 7, 6, and 15 kicking points in his last five games. He's been a great play for fantasy and one of the better kickers so far in 2026.

news.body: Cam Little did not attempt a field goal but made all six of his PATs in Sunday's 42-7 blowout of the Colts.
news.head: Cam Little hits a half-dozen PATs in Week 8 win
news.impact: Little gave fantasy managers six points, all on PATs, in Sunday's blowout. One of the league's best kickers, Little remains 10-of-12 on FG attempts with a long of 60 yards. He's also 22 of 23 on PATs.

news.body: Cam Little connected on his lone field goal attempts and 4-of-4 extra point attempts in a 34-31 loss to Houston.
news.head: Cam Little perfect in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Little connected on a 60-yard field goal for his lone make of the day. Little has missed just one kick this season and continues to show that he has one of the strongest legs in the game. Little and the Jaguars will head to their bye in Week 7.

news.body: Cam Little made both of his field-goal attempts and 1-of-2 PATs in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
news.head: Cam Little nails long game-winner in Week 5
news.impact: After missing a PAT that could have put the Jaguars up by three late in the fourth quarter, Little got a chance to make up for it with just one tick of the clock remaining during a wild finish Sunday. Little made good on the opportunity, drilling a 57-yard attempt as time expired to give the Jaguars a victory. That is Little's longest make of the season through five weeks, and he's now 9-of-11 overall on field goals for the campaign. He's one of the top kickers in the league.

news.body: Cameron Dicker went 3-for-3 on his field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point attempt in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Houston Texans.
news.head: Cameron Dicker perfect in loss Sunday
news.impact: Dicker was one of the lone bright spots for the Chargers on Sunday. He totaled ten points over the course of the game and made all four of his kicks, including one from 52 yards out. His fantasy value will continue to be limited with how bad Los Angeles' offense has been playing this season.

news.body: Cameron Dicker went 3-for-3 on his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Cameron Dicker scores nine points in loss Sunday
news.impact: The Chargers suffered another tough loss at the hands of the Rams on Sunday, but Dicker did his job in that matchup. He made all three of his attempted kicks and was responsible for all nine of the team's points over the course of the afternoon. He may not see as many opportunities on a game-to-game basis as fantasy managers would like, however, with how bad Los Angeles' offense looks.

news.body: Cameron Dicker made both of his field-goal attempts in the Chargers' 22-6 loss to the Chiefs in Week 6.
news.head: Cameron Dicker Scores Chargers' Only Points in Week 6
news.impact: Dicker connected from 23 and 30 yards for all six of Los Angeles' points. He did his job when called upon, but the Chargers' inability to consistently reach scoring range limits his fantasy ceiling.

news.body: Cameron Dicker made his only field-goal attempt and both of his PATs in Sunday's 23-17 loss to the Broncos.
news.head: Cameron Dicker puts five points on the board Sunday
news.impact: The Chargers' anemic offense just hasn't given Dicker enough chances to be a real fantasy asset among kickers through the first five weeks. The fifth-year pro is 7-of-9 on field-goal attempts through five games with a long of 42 yards. He's made all nine of his PATs to this point.

news.body: Chris Boswell made 2-of-3 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Chris Boswell connects on 5-of-6 kicks Sunday
news.impact: Boswell made field goals from 20 and 37 yards out. His miss came from 57 yards out. He remains one of the more consistent kickers for fantasy managers.

news.body: Chris Boswell connected on all three of his field goal attempts and made his only PAT in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints.
news.head: Chris Boswell leads Steelers to win on Sunday
news.impact: Boswell benefited from the Steelers' offense failing to move the ball effectively down into the end zone, resulting in the team primarily putting up field goals. He should be a consistent and top-end option with the Steelers' offense humming, touchdowns or not.

news.body: Chris Boswell made 4-of-5 field goal attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Chris Boswell connects on 4-of-5 field goals Sunday
news.impact: Boswell made field goals from 52, 39, 58 and 20 yards out. His lone miss came from 48 yards out in the first half.

news.body: Chris Boswell hit all four of his PATs and both of his field goal attempts in the Steelers' 34-22 win over the Colts on Sunday.
news.head: Chris Boswell puts up 10 kicking points in win
news.impact: Boswell was making all of his chances count in this game, perfect for the fantasy managers who started him. He's been a bit up and down this year due to some misses, but that's to be expected. And if it's any consolation, two of his three misses were on field goal tries beyond 50 yards.

news.body: Eddy Pineiro made his lone field goal attempt and all five extra point attempts.
news.head: Eddy Pineiro makes lone field goal Sunday
news.impact: It was a busy day for Pineiro, but only one of his six attempts was a field goal.

news.body: Eddy Pineiro did not attempt a field goal and made 2-of-3 PATs in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
news.head: Eddy Pineiro contributes just two points in Sunday's loss
news.impact: Pineiro missed another PAT on Sunday, and he's now 21 of 25 on the season. He's also just 6-of-9 on FG attempts. Pineiro should be a solid fantasy option with the 49ers' potent offense, but he's been shaky at best.

news.body: Eddy Pineiro made his lone field-goal attempt while adding two extra points in a 23-17 win over the Commanders in Week 6.
news.head: Eddy Pineiro makes one FG in Week 6
news.impact: Pineiro hit a 33-yard field goal in the third quarter to give the 49ers their last points of the contest. The veteran kicker has made six of his nine field goals while adding 19 extra points this season. He will take on the Falcons in Week 7.

news.body: Eddy Pineiro went 1-of-2 field goals and 3-of-3 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Eddy Pineiro hits go-ahead field goal Sunday
news.impact: Pineiro missed a field goal from 52 yards out to begin the second half. He made the one that went on to win the game for San Francisco just after the two-minute warning.

news.body: Evan McPherson connected on both of his field goal attempts and 4-of-4 extra point attempts in a 34-17 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Evan McPherson perfect in Week 9 win
news.impact: McPherson made field goals from 43 and 57 yards out to help pace the Bengals to their sixth win of the season. McPherson continues to have an excellent season and will look to continue that against the Steelers in Week 10.

news.body: Evan McPherson made all five of his extra points in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Evan McPherson makes five XPs in Week 8
news.impact: McPherson did not attempt any field goals in the high-scoring win. The veteran kicker has now converted all 10 of his field-goal attempts and added 24 extra points on the season. He will take on the Falcons in Week 9.

news.body: Evan McPherson connected on all five of his extra point attempts in a 35-13 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Evan McPherson perfect in Week 7 win
news.impact: McPherson was not asked to attempt a field goal, but was perfect after all five Bengals' touchdowns. The 27-year-old kicker has yet to miss an attempt this season an will look to continue that in Week 7 against the Titans.

news.body: Evan McPherson went 4-for-4 on his extra-point attempts and made his lone field-goal attempt in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Evan McPherson scores seven points Sunday
news.impact: McPherson did his job on Sunday, making all five of his kicks in a win over the Dolphins. He should continue to be a good fantasy option moving forward after the team's bye week in Week 6.

news.body: Jake Bates converted all four of his field goal attempts as well as his lone extra point attempt to finish with 13 points in the Lions' 19-9 win over the Dolphins in Week 9.
news.head: Jake Bates racks up 13 points in Week 9
news.impact: Bates continues to take advantage of playing behind a prolific Detroit offense, registering seven or more points in each of his eight contests. The kicker remains locked in as an impactful option in kicker formats entering a Week 10 contest against the New England Patriots.

news.body: Jake Bates converted his only extra point attempt while also making two of three field goal attempts to record seven points in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings in Week 8.
news.head: Jake Bates misses field goal in Week 8
news.impact: Bates has taken advantage of sizeable opportunities behind a high-powered offense, finishing with seven or more points in each of his seven contests. The kicker remains a reliable option for fantasy managers ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Miami Dolphins.

news.body: Jake Bates went 2-for-2 on his field-goal attempts and 2-for-2 on his extra-point attempts in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Jake Bates scores eight points in win Sunday
news.impact: Bates did his job on Sunday, making all four of his attempted kicks in a win over the Packers. He should continue to be a good fantasy option at the kicker position moving forward, considering how effective Detroit is at moving the ball.

news.body: Jake Bates went 6-for-6 on his extra-point attempts and made his lone field-goal attempt in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Jake Bates scores nine points in win Sunday
news.impact: The veteran kicker had a good game on Sunday, knocking in all seven of his kicks in the team's blowout win over Arizona. He should continue to be a good fantasy option at the kicker position for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Jason Myers made his lone field goal attempt and two extra points against the Cardinals.
news.head: Jason Myers connects on field goal Sunday
news.impact: Myers was able to bounce back following his struggles last week.

news.body: Jason Myers went 1-for-2 on his field-goal attempt and missed his lone extra-point attempt in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Jason Myers misses two kicks in loss Monday
news.impact: Myers missed two kicks on Monday night. One of them wasn't his fault, as it was blocked by Chicago, but there were still four points left out on the field by the veteran kicker. He isn't expected to be among the top kickers in fantasy over the back half of the season.

news.body: Jason Myers made both of his field-goal attempts and added two extra points in a 20-3 win over the Chiefs in Week 7.
news.head: Jason Myers makes two FGs in Week 7
news.impact: Myers hit field goals from 25 and 35 yards out in the win over the previously undefeated Chiefs. The veteran kicker has now hit 14 of his 15 attempts on the year. He will take on the Bears in Week 8.

news.body: Jason Myers hit two of three field goal attempts in the Seahawks' 17-14 loss to the Broncos on Thursday. He did not attempt a PAT.
news.head: Jason Myers has big miss in loss to Denver
news.impact: Meyers had a miss in the third quarter that ended up being crucial in the game, as the game went to overtime tied 14-14. Had Meyers connected, it's entirely possible the Seahawks pull off the low-scoring win. However, history is history, and the only thing he can do is move on.

news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn went 5-for-5 on his field-goal attempts and 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts in Sunday's win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn scores 14 points in win Sunday
news.impact: Fairbairn had a fantastic game on Sunday. He scored 14 points and made all eight of his kicks in this win over the Texans, including one from 56 yards out. He will continue to be a good fantasy option at the position moving forward.

news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn connected on 2-of-2 field goal attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn makes both field goals Sunday
news.impact: Fairbairn made field goals from 58 and 57 yards out. He remains a reliable kicker for fantasy managers.

news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn made 4-of-4 field goal attempts and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn connects on four field goals Sunday
news.impact: Fairbairn made field goals from 45, 35, 26 and 53 yards out all in the first half. He remains a steady option for fantasy managers.

news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn connected on 3-of-3 field goals and extra points on Sunday.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn connects on all six kicks Sunday
news.impact: Fairbairn made field goals from 51, 39 and 54 yards. He remains a steady option for fantasy managers.

news.body: Matt Gay made his lone field goal attempt and both extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Matt Gay connects on three kicks Sunday
news.impact: Gay made his lone field goal from 50 yards out.

news.body: Matt Gay connected on his lone field goal attempt and 5-of-5 extra point attempts in a 38-33 win over the Jets.
news.head: Matt Gay perfect in Week 8 win
news.impact: Gay connected on his lone field goal from 53-yards out late in the fourth quarter. The 32-year-old had missed two field goals over his last three games. Gay and the Raiders will take on the 49ers in Week 9.

news.body: Matt Gay converted three of his four field goal attempts to finish with nine points in the Raiders' 35-21 loss to the Los Angeles Rams in Week 7.
news.head: Matt Gay misses field goal in Week 7
news.impact: Gay has taken advantage of his opportunities to this point, recording six or more points in five of six contests. The kicker will look for more success against the Buffalo Bills in Week 8.

news.body: Matt Gay went 3-for-3 on his field-goal attempts and 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Matt Gay scores 12 points in loss Sunday
news.impact: Gay did his job on Sunday, knocking down all six of his attempted kicks in Las Vegas' narrow loss to the Buffalo Bills. Fantasy managers should be happy with his performance and should continue to view him as a decent fantasy option at the position moving forward.

news.body: Spencer Shrader made all three of his field goals and added two extra points in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
news.head: Spencer Shrader hits three FGs in Week 9
news.impact: Shrader was perfect in the close loss. He hit field goals from 47, 59, and 50 yards out for the Colts. The veteran kicker now has 22 field goals in 24 tries, including eight from at least 50 yards away. He will take on the Dolphins in Week 10.

news.body: Spencer Shrader did not attempt a field goal and made his only PAT in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Spencer Shrader puts just one point on the board in Week 8
news.impact: Simply put, the Colts were terrible on Sunday afternoon in Jacksonville. That led to Shrader not getting much of a chance to help fantasy managers. The third-year kicker is still tied atop the NFL with 19 field goals made through eight games.

news.body: Spencer Shrader went 1-for-3 on field goal attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Spencer Shrader misses two field goals Sunday
news.impact: Shrader missed field goals from 56 and 48 yards out. He has been more reliable on the season than he was this week.

news.body: Spencer Shrader hit both of his field goal attempts and both PATs in the Colts' 26-20 loss to the Titans on Sunday.
news.head: Spencer Shrader has 8 kicking points in loss
news.impact: Shrader continued his impressive streak of scoring, albeit a little less than the output he's been producing recently. Keep him in lineups as a top-tier kicking option.

news.body: Tyler Bass made all three of his field-goal attempts and both PATs in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Tyler Bass puts 11 points on the board in Week 9
news.impact: Bass made good on all of his opportunities in Monday's win, remaining an impressive 19-of-19 on FG attempts this season. The veteran kicker is an excellent fantasy option given the Bills' offensive prowess.

news.body: Tyler Bass connected on 3-of-3 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts in a 36-10 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Tyler Bass perfect in Week 8 win
news.impact: Bass connected on field goals from 22, 51, and 56 yards out in the first half to help pace the Bills to the win. Bass has not missed a field goal attempt this season and will look to continue that against the Vikings in Week 9.

news.body: Tyler Bass went 4-for-4 on his field-goal attempts and 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts in Sunday's 33-30 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Tyler Bass scores 15 points in win Sunday
news.impact: Bass played quite well on Sunday. He made all seven of his kicks and was responsible for 15 of Buffalo's points on the afternoon, which made a big impact in a game that they won by just three points. He will continue to be a good option at the kicker position for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Tyler Bass made all three of his field-goal attempts and hit two of his three extra points in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5.
news.head: Tyler Bass wins it in OT for Bills in Week 5
news.impact: Bass hit field goals from 49, 23, and 45 yards out in the win. His 45-yard attempt won the game for the Bills with two minutes left in overtime. Bass has now hit all 10 of his field-goal attempts this season. He will take on the Raiders in Week 6.

news.body: Will Reichard made both of his field-goal attempts in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Will Reichard makes a pair of field goals in Week 9 loss
news.impact: The Vikings' offense was almost completely stifled Monday night, leaving Reichard as the only Minnesota player to put up any points. The third-year kicker is 1-of-5 in the NFL with as many as 20 field goals made so far this season, and he's missed just two in the process.

news.body: Will Reichard converted his only extra point attempt while also missing his lone field goal attempt in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions in Week 8.
news.head: Will Reichard misses field goal in Week 8
news.impact: Reichard struggled to make an impact Sunday, registering less than nine points for the first time in his last six contests. The kicker will look to get back on track against the Buffalo Bills in Week 9.

news.body: Will Reichard made 3-of-4 field goal attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Will Reichard makes three field goals Sunday
news.impact: Reichard connected on field goals from 28, 47 and 52 yards out. He missed from 59 yards on an attempt that was blocked. He remains a fairly safe kicker for fantasy managers.

news.body: Will Reichard converted both of his extra point attempts as well as all three of his field goal attempts to finish with 11 points in the Vikings' 23-13 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 5.
news.head: Will Reichard racks up 11 points in Week 5 win
news.impact: Reichard continues a dynamic start to the season for head coach Kevin O'Connell, racking up seven or more points in each of the first five games. The kicker remains one of the more dynamic options in associated formats as Minnesota enters a Week 6 bye.

news.body: Aaron Rodgers completed 13-of-25 passes for 172 yards with an interception in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
news.head: Aaron Rodgers throws for 172 yards Sunday
news.impact: Rodgers did not need to do much in Sunday's win as the ground game dominated for Pittsburgh. He had one big throw to Darnell Washington that went for 58 yards. His interception was on a dropped pass by D.K. Metcalf. The Steelers are on their bye next week.

news.body: Aaron Rodgers completed 19-of-30 passes for 212 yards and a touchdown in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints. He also ran three times for six yards.
news.head: Aaron Rodgers quiet in win over Saints
news.impact: Rodgers had been on a hot streak coming into this game, and the overseas trip did him in, snapping his streak of multi-touchdown games. It was an unfortunate outing for those who expected a few more fireworks in this matchup, but down games are part of the fantasy football experience.

news.body: Aaron Rodgers completed 33-of-49 passes for 253 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers.
news.head: Aaron Rodgers throws for 253 yards Sunday
news.impact: Rodgers threw an interception early, but he was able to bounce back and lead the Steelers to an overtime win. He was able to connect 11 times with both DK Metcalf and Germie Bernard. He'll be in the streaming conversation next week against the Saints.

news.body: Aaron Rodgers completed 22 of 31 passes for 235 yards and three touchdowns, also running once for six yards in the Steelers' 34-22 win over the Colts on Sunday.
news.head: Aaron Rodgers tosses three touchdowns in win
news.impact: Rodgers had himself a day against the struggling Colts defense, taking only a single sack and not throwing an interception. He has been on fire in the last few weeks, with three touchdowns in each of his last three games. He's a streamable option if the matchup is right, and that could be as soon as next week against the Buccaneers.

news.body: Brock Purdy completed 17-of-25 passes for 232 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in the 49ers 38-17 win over the Raiders.
news.head: Brock Purdy totals three touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Purdy also added 40 yards and another score on the ground. Despite being without practically his entire wide receiver room, Purdy still found a way to make it work. He faces a very bad Cowboys defense next week.

news.body: Brock Purdy completed 27 of 40 passes for 288 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
news.head: Brock Purdy throws for 288 yards, two picks in Sunday's loss
news.impact: Purdy threw just two interceptions over the first six games of the season. He doubled that total Sunday, including one late in the fourth quarter during a comeback attempt by the 49ers. Purdy had the yardage and found the end zone once in this one, but it was ultimately a game Purdy would probably like to forget. He's still having an excellent season going into the 49ers' bye.

news.body: Brocky Purdy completed 21 of his 29 passes for 264 yads and one touchdown while adding five rushes for 28 yards in a 23-17 win over the Commanders in Week 6.
news.head: Brock Purdy throws one TD in MNF win
news.impact: Purdy was efficient in the win over Washington on Monday night, although the offense slowed down a bit after halftime. His lone touchdown pass went to George Kittle early in the first quarter. Purdy has been one of the top fantasy QBs this season, posting 1,460 passing yards, 14 touchdowns, and two interceptions across six games. He will be a high-end fantasy option in Week 7 vs. the Falcons.

news.body: Brock Purdy completed 19-of-29 passes for 189 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in the 49ers 32-29 win over the Seahawks.
news.head: Brock Purdy tosses two touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Purdy led two scoring drives on short field off two turnovers early in the game. He connected several times with Mike Evans late including a two-point conversion. He was sacked three times, the first time he had been taken to the ground all season. He draws a strong matchup next week against the Commanders.

news.body: Bryce Young completed 28 of 39 passes for 276 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception while rushing once for 13 yards in the Panthers' 26-21 loss to the Broncos in Week 9.
news.head: Bryce Young throws three touchdowns in Week 9
news.impact: Young threw touchdowns to Tommy Tremble, Darren Waller, and Tetairoa McMillan against Denver's defense. The problem? He also threw an interception in the end zone and lost a fumble on Carolina's final possession. Young produced three passing touchdowns against a difficult matchup, but the turnovers proved costly. He gets the Saints in Week 10.

news.body: Bryce Young completed 23 of 41 passes for 209 yards with one touchdown and one interception in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
news.head: Bryce Young throws one touchdown, one pick in Thursday's loss
news.impact: Young put up a so-so performance overall in Green Bay on Thursday night. Considering he was absolutely harassed by the Packers' pass rush, going down for six sacks, his output could've, and probably should've, been much worse. Still, since a strong start to the season, it's been a tough couple of weeks for Young in back-to-back losses. Things won't get any easier against the Broncos' defense in Week 9.

news.body: Bryce Young completed 14-of-27 passes for 163 yards with a touchdown and two picks and a fumble in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to the Bucs on Sunday. He also ran once for nine yards.
news.head: Bryce Young struggles in loss to Bucs
news.impact: Young had his worst game of the season in this one, with his top two receivers, Tetairoa McMillan and Jalen Coker, held to just five catches for 49 yards combined. He better shake off this loss quickly, as the Panthers face off against the Packers on Thursday night.

news.body: Carolina Panthers quarterback Bryce Young completed 20 of 39 passes for 281 yards and two touchdowns against the Philadelphia Eagles in Week 6.
news.head: Bryce Young tosses pair of scores in Week 6 win
news.impact: Young delivered against a talented Philly defense with his fourth multi-touchdown game in five weeks. He has two scores and no turnovers in each of the last two games, emerging from the Week 5 bye with the same flair. Young has at least 280 passing yards in every game, giving him an impressive floor at quarterback.

news.body: Caleb Williams completed 22 of his 37 passes for 279 yards, two touchdowns, and four interceptions while adding five rushes for 16 yards in a 27-24 win over the Buccaneers in Week 9.
news.head: Caleb Williams throws two TDs, four INTs in Week 9
news.impact: Williams came into the game with just one interception on the season, but he struggled on Sunday night, throwing four picks in the close win over Tampa Bay. His touchdowns went to Luther Burden III and Rome Odunze in the contest. Williams has thrown for 1,546 yards, eight touchdowns, and five interceptions in six games for the Bears this year. A solid fantasy QB1 for the rest of the season, Williams will be on bye in Week 10 before a Week 11 matchup vs. the Saints.

news.body: Caleb Williams completed 24-of-34 passing attempts for 247 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 34-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: Caleb Williams scores once in big win Monday
news.impact: Williams played very well on Monday night, but since most of Chicago's touchdowns came on the ground, that didn't come through on the stat sheet very strongly. Still, fantasy managers should be ecstatic with how this Chicago looks at this point in the season and should expect Williams to be a strong starter over the back half of the year.

news.body: Caleb Williams completed 22 of 33 passes for 308 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions in Thursday's 30-24 win over the Patriots.
news.head: Caleb Williams throws for more than 300 yards in Week 7 win
news.impact: Williams added 18 yards on five carries to his strong stat line from Thursday night. The third-year pro has been excellent since returning from injury, leading the Bears to two victories over the past five days. Williams has cleared 300 yards in each of those games, tossing three touchdowns without an interception.

news.body: Caleb Williams completed 30-of-36 pass attempts for 305 yards and one touchdown while also rushing four times for three yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Caleb Williams efficient in Week 6 win over Falcons
news.impact: Williams was impactful in his return to the lineup for head coach Ben Johnson, surpassing 300 passing yards for the first time in his three contests while battling a hamstring injury. The dual-threat signal-caller remains a dynamic lineup option in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the New England Patriots.

news.body: C.J. Stroud completed 21-of-35 passing attempts for 384 yards, five touchdowns, and one interception in Sunday's 44-22 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: C.J. Stroud tosses five touchdowns in win Sunday
news.impact: Stroud played a superb game on Sunday. He finished with over 400 total yards on the day and threw five touchdowns, while limiting himself to just one turnover in the process. He has been playing fantastic for most of the season and should continue to be a good week-to-week starter for the foreseeable future.

news.body: C.J. Stroud completed 17-of-28 passes for 153 yards and two touchdowns in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
news.head: C.J. Stroud tosses two touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Stroud did not throw for many yards, but he also didn't commit any turnovers. The Texans are heading into their bye next week.

news.body: C.J. Stroud completed 24-of-34 pass attempts for 312 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception in the win over the Jaguars. He rushed for five yards on his lone rushing attempt.
news.head: C.J. Stroud tosses three touchdowns in Week 6 win
news.impact: Stroud found 10 different pass catchers as he spread the ball around effectively and kept the Jaguars' defense guessing. Stroud has eclipsed 300 yards passing in three games this season and set a new season high with three touchdown passes. Houston will take on the Giants in Week 7.

news.body: C.J. Stroud completed 26-of-34 passes for 261 yards and one touchdown in the Texans 26-3 win over the Titans.
news.head: C.J. Stroud totals two touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Stroud also added a rushing score at the goal line. He was able to take care of the ball in a game where the Texans defense dominated. He'll be a QB2 next week against the Jaguars.

news.body: Dak Prescott completed 21 of 34 passes for 335 yards and two touchdowns in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9.
news.head: Dak Prescott throws two TDs in Week 9 win
news.impact: Prescott turned in a solid game, tying a season-high with his 335 passing yards. One of Prescott's touchdown passes went to CeeDee Lamb while the other went to Jake Ferguson. Prescott has now thrown 16 touchdowns and five interceptions through nine games. He will be a mid-range QB1 in Week 10 vs. the 49ers.

news.body: Dak Prescott completed 19-of-29 pass attempts for 195 yards and one touchdown while also rushing seven times for 20 yards and one touchdown in the Cowboys' 33-30 loss to the Cardinals in Week 8.
news.head: Dak Prescott records two touchdowns in Week 8 loss to Cardinals
news.impact: Prescott was unable to find consistent success Sunday, finishing with under 200 passing yards for the first time in his last seven contests. The quarterback will look to get back on track against a leaky Indianapolis Colts defense in Week 9.

news.body: Dak Prescott completed 15-of-27 passing attempts for 212 yards and three touchdowns in Monday night's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Dak Prescott tosses three touchdowns in win Monday
news.impact: Prescott had a pretty nice showing on Monday night. He totaled over 200 yards on the night and was able to score three touchdowns while leading the Cowboys to a comfortable win over Philadelphia. He will continue to be a good depth piece or streaming option in most leagues moving forward.

news.body: Dak Prescott completed 34 of his 54 passes for 258 yards, one touchdown, and two interceptions while adding two rushes for seven yards in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
news.head: Dak Prescott throws one TD in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Prescott and the Cowboys were shut out by the Packers in the first half before showing some life after halftime. The veteran's lone TD pass went to Ryan Flournoy with 44 seconds left in the contest. Prescott survived an injury scare in the first half as he took a huge hit after a pass attempt and appeared to be favoring his ribs. He ultimately didn't miss any time in the game, but it is something worth monitoring this week. Prescott has now thrown for 1,639 yards, 10 touchdowns, and five interceptions in six games this season. He will be a low-end QB1 in fantasy in Week 7 vs. the Eagles.

news.body: Drake Maye completed 21-of-38 pass attempts for 299 yards, three touchdowns, and three interceptions while also rushing once for three yards in the Patriots' 45-27 Week 9 loss to the Packers.
news.head: Drake Maye offers mixed results in Week 9 loss to Packers
news.impact: Maye continues a dynamic stretch behind center, recording three or more touchdowns in each of his last six contests. The quarterback will look to offer fantasy managers another impactful option against a shaky Detroit Lions defense in Week 10.

news.body: Drake Maye completed 16-of-20 passes for 199 yards and two touchdowns, also running eight times for five yards and a score in the Patriots' 24-19 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
news.head: Drake Maye puts up three touchdowns in win over Miami
news.impact: Maye struggled mightily in the first half, but turned things around in the second half on his way to three touchdowns, two through the air, one on the ground. It wasn't all pretty, but he made it work for fantasy managers, who are riding high on his hot streak.

news.body: Drake Maye was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Drake Maye (shoulder) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Maye will be a QB1 play this week for fantasy managers against the Dolphins.

news.body: Drake Maye completed 24 of 31 passes for 321 yards with two touchdowns and one interception, adding 26 yards and another touchdown on four carries during Thursday's 30-24 loss to the Bears.
news.head: Drake Maye accounts for three touchdowns in Week 7 loss
news.impact: The Patriots certainly wanted the win, but fantasy managers enjoyed a big performance from Maye. The third-year QB threw for more than 300 yards for the second time in the last three weeks, and he's now scored 11 total touchdowns during that span. Maye will be a certain start at Miami in Week 8.

news.body: Drew Lock remained limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Drew Lock (elbow/oblique) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Lock remains on track to start Sunday's game against the Raiders for the Seahawks.

news.body: Drew Lock was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Drew Lock (elbow/oblique) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Lock remains on track to start another game for the Seahawks on Sunday against the Raiders.

news.body: Drew Lock (oblique) has suffered a minor oblique injury but is still expected to start against the Raiders in Week 10.
news.head: Drew Lock (oblique) has minor oblique injury, expected to play vs Vegas
news.impact: Lock suffered the injury later on in the Seahawks win over the Cardinals, and with Darnold already ruled out, if Lock cannot go, responsibility would fall on Jalen Milroe to keep the offense going.

news.body: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Drew Lock suffered an oblique injury and it’s up in the air if he’ll be available next week.
news.head: Drew Lock (oblique) uncertain for Week 10
news.impact: Lock was pretty clearly hampered to end the game on Sunday against the Cardinals. Pending the status of Sam Darnold, it could be Jalen Milroe getting his first career start in Week 10 against the Raiders.

news.body: Jared Goff is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Patriots.
news.head: Jared Goff (chest) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Goff was limited in practice earlier this week. He will be good to go on Sunday.

news.body: Jared Goff (chest) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Jared Goff (chest) upgraded to full participant Thursday
news.impact: Goff was limited on Wednesday due to a chest issue of some kind, but he was able to log a full practice on Thursday and should be good to go for Sunday's game. He's primed for a bounce back after having a disappointing output for the team's last two games.

news.body: Jared Goff completed 17-of-25 pass attempts for 170 yards and one interception in the Lions' 19-9 Week 9 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Jared Goff bottled up in Week 9 win
news.impact: Goff is in the middle of an uncomfortable stretch behind center, passing for less than 180 yards in each of the last two games. The quarterback will look to return to his impactful form against the New England Patriots in Week 10.

news.body: Jared Goff completed 18-of-25 pass attempts for 176 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in the Lions' 19-15 Week 8 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Jared Goff held in check in Week 8 win
news.impact: Goff was mostly held in check by a stout Minnesota defense, finishing with under 200 passing yards for the first time this season. The quarterback will look to get back on track in a favorable matchup against the Miami Dolphins in Week 9.

news.body: Jayden Daniels completed 23 of his 33 passes for 249 yards, three touchdowns, and two interceptions while adding 28 rushing yards on 11 carries in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.
news.head: Jayden Daniels throws three TDs in TNF win
news.impact: Daniels wasn't his sharpest, throwing his first two interceptions of the season, but he got the job done. He threw two long touchdowns in the game, including a game-winning 32-yard TD toss to Stefon Diggs with 57 seconds left in regulation. Daniels now has 1,499 passing yards, 10 touchdowns, and two interceptions through seven games this year. He will be a solid QB1 in fantasy in Week 11 vs. the Bengals.

news.body: Jayden Daniels completed 24/35 passes for 274 yards and a touchdown while rushing four times for 16 yards.
news.head: Jayden Daniels nears 300 total yards in loss
news.impact: Despite his second-highest passing total of the season, Daniels once again struggled in the clutch and was unable to score in the waning seconds of the one-score game. Daniels and the Commanders will look to bounce back on Thursday Night Football for an inter-division game against the Giants, where he will be a mid-QB1 option.

news.body: Jayden Daniels completed 16 of his 29 passes for 217 yards and one touchdown while adding 23 yards on two rushes in a 27-10 win over the Eagles in Week 8.
news.head: Jayden Daniels throws one TD in Week 8 win
news.impact: Daniels didn't post huge numbers in the Sunday night win but it didn't matter against a sputtering Philadelphia team. His lone touchdown pass went to Stefon Diggs on an eight-yard completion in the second quarter. Daniels has thrown for 976 yards, six touchdowns, and zero interceptions in five contests this season. He will be a solid QB1 in fantasy in Week 9 vs. the Rams.

news.body: Jayden Daniels completed 29 of his 40 passes for 300 yards and two touchdowns while adding four rushes for 10 yards in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6.
news.head: Jayden Daniels throws for 300 yards, two TDs in Week 6
news.impact: Unlike Week 5, Daniels didn't do much damage on the ground, but he made up for it with a solid day in the passing attack. His touchdown passes both came in the second half with one going to Stefon Diggs and the other to Rachaad White. Daniels has thrown for 759 yards and five touchdowns across four games this season. A solid QB1 in fantasy going forward, he will be on bye in Week 7 before taking on the Eagles in Week 8.

news.body: Joe Burrow completed 24-of-29 pass attempts for 271 yards and three touchdowns in a 34-17 win over the Falcons. Burrow also rushed for seven yards and a touchdown on three attempts.
news.head: Joe Burrow tosses three touchdowns in Week 9 win
news.impact: Burrow found Ja'Marr Chase once and Tee Higgins twice for his three passing touchdowns in another stellar performance. Burrow has at least three passing touchdowns in each of his last four games. The Bengals will look to continue their strong play against the Steelers in Week 10.

news.body: Joe Burrow completed 38 of his 48 passes for 462 yards, five touchdowns, and three interceptions while adding three rushes for 10 yards and a touchdown on the ground in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Joe Burrow throws five TDs, three INTs in Week 8 win
news.impact: Burrow turned in a huge game as the Titans surprisingly gave the Bengals all they could handle. The Cincy quarterback is heating up of late as he's thrown 13 touchdowns over his past three contests. Overall, Burrow has 20 touchdowns and six interceptions through seven games. He will be a high-end QB1 in Week 8 vs. the Falcons.

news.body: Joe Burrow completed 22-of-30 passes for 292 yards and four touchdowns in the Bengals' 35-13 win over the Ravens. He rushed for 12 yards on two carries.
news.head: Joe Burrow tosses four touchdowns in Week 7 win
news.impact: Burrow and the Bengals' offense came alive in the second half, erasing a 13-0 deficit with a 35 point performance to close out the comeback win. Burrow has eight touchdown passes in his last two games and will look to continue his recent strong play against the Titans in Week 8.

news.body: Joe Burrow completed 23-of-32 passing attempts for 190 yards and four touchdowns in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Joe Burrow throws four touchdowns in win Sunday
news.impact: Burrow looked great on Sunday. He scored four touchdowns through the air en route to a win over the Dolphins, which left him with a great fantasy total on the day. The Bengals are now heading into their bye week but he should continue to be a great fantasy option when the team is back out on the field.

news.body: Jordan Love completed 23-of-29 pass attempts for 372 yards and three touchdowns while also rushing once for 13 yards and one touchdown in the Packers' 25-27 Week 9 win over the Patriots.
news.head: Jordan Love accounts for four touchdowns in Week 9 win over Patriots
news.impact: Love continues an impactful stretch behind center, recording two or more touchdowns in each of nine games. The quarterback has offered fantasy managers a dynamic quarterback option behind an inconsistent Green Bay offensive line to this point, with a difficult Week 10 contest against the Minnesota Vikings up next.

news.body: Jordan Love completed 30 of 41 passes for 288 yards with three touchdowns and one interception in Thursday's 27-19 win over the Panthers.
news.head: Jordan Love fires three TD passes in Thursday night win
news.impact: Aside from an early fourth-quarter pick deep into n Carolina territory, Love was pretty locked in on Thursday. The Panthers did not generate much of a pass rush, failing to sack Love even once, and that kept the Green Bay QB comfortable in the pocket most of the night. Love has thrown an interception in three straight games now, but he has countered that with six touchdown passes and an additional score on the ground. He's also averaged just under 280 passing yards per game in that span.

news.body: Jordan Love completed 27-of-45 passing attempts for 274 yards, two touchdowns, and an interception in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Jordan Love throws two touchdowns in loss Sunday
news.impact: Love had an okay game on Sunday. He threw for close to 300 yards and two touchdowns over the course of the game, but he also threw two interceptions and didn't have a very high completion percentage on the day. He will continue to be a viable week-to-week streaming option moving forward.

news.body: Jordan Love (back) is without an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Jordan Love (back) without injury designation for Sunday
news.impact: Love was managing a minor back issue early on in the week, but to no surprise, he carries no injury designation heading into the weekend and will be good to go for Sunday's game. He should be considered a solid streaming option this week in a favorable matchup against Detroit.

news.body: Josh Allen completed 21 of 31 passes for 234 yards with one touchdown and one interception, adding 15 yards on six carries in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Josh Allen turns in decent performance Monday night
news.impact: This performance was certainly below the norm for Allen, but considering it came against arguably the league's top defense, it was serviceable. Allen eclipsed 2,000 yards passing for the season in this one, and he's now up to a dozen touchdown passes along with a whopping nine rushing scores. Allen remains one of the top fantasy assets in the league regardless of position. He should be set for a larger output against the Jets in Week 10.

news.body: Josh Allen completed 21-of-34 passes for 289 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception in a 36-10 win over the Ravens. He rushed for 30 yards and a touchdown on seven attempts.
news.head: Josh Allen accounts for three touchdowns in Week 8 win
news.impact: Allen opened the scoring with a one-yard rush in first quarter and found DJ Moore and Dalton Kincaid on passing touchdowns to ice the game in the fourth quarter. Allen has at least two touchdowns in every game so far this season. He will look to continue to build on his strong start to the season against the Vikings in Week 9.

news.body: Josh Allen completed 23-of-33 passing attempts for 255 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 33-30 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Josh Allen scores twice in win Sunday
news.impact: Allen played a solid game on Sunday, racking up 255 yards and two touchdowns through the air while not turning the ball over at all. He had just one yard on the ground in this game, however, which is extremely uncommon for him, especially after he rushed for over 120 yards last week. Fantasy managers should continue to view him as a top-tier fantasy option moving forward.

news.body: Josh Allen completed 12 of his 19 passes for 210 yards, one touchdown, and one interception while adding 121 yards and a rushing touchdown on the ground in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5.
news.head: Josh Allen rushes for 121 yards, TD in Week 5 win
news.impact: Allen didn't have his best passing game but he dominated the Rams on the ground in the thrilling Monday night win as he easily set a season-high in rushing yards. His lone touchdown pass went to Keon Coleman in the third quarter. Allen has thrown for 1,249 yards, seven touchdowns, and four interceptions through five games this season. He will remain a top-three fantasy quarterback heading into Week 6 against the Raiders.

news.body: Lamar Jackson (thumb) will miss 6-10 weeks after undergoing thumb surgery.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (thumb) undergoes surgery, out 6-10 weeks
news.impact: Jackson seems likely to miss the rest of the season while rehabbing from thumb surgery this week. However, that is not definite, as head coach Jesse Minter stated that the "timelines are challenging to predict." The Ravens traded for veteran QB Jacoby Brissett last week, and he's expected to helm the Ravens' offense starting Monday night against the Chargers.

news.body: The Ravens placed Lamar Jackson on injured reserve.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (thumb) officially placed on IR
news.impact: Jackson is expected to require surgery on his thumb injury. His status to return this season remains up in the air.

news.body: Lamar Jackson (thumb) will require surgery on his injured thumb and will head to injured reserve.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (thumb)will need surgery for thumb, heading to IR
news.impact: It’s a brutal loss for the Ravens and fantasy managers depending on Lamar’s return. The Ravens offense struggled to get anything going with Lamar out, and it wasn’t helped when backup Tyler Huntley also went down with injury. Jackson will now miss at least the next four games, and quite possibly more.

news.body: Lamar Jackson (thumb) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday’s contest between the Baltimore Ravens and Buffalo Bills according to Mike Garafolo.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (thumb) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Jackson suffered the thumb injury while following through on his lone pass attempt, finishing 0-for-1 through the air. Tyler Huntley takes over behind center against the Bills.

news.body: Matthew Stafford completed 26 of 43 passes for 228 yards in Sunday's win against the Commanders. He also threw one touchdown and one interception while adding one rush for one yard.
news.head: Matthew Stafford tosses one touchdown, one interception in win
news.impact: Stafford hyper-targeted standout wide receiver, Puka Nacua, who accounted for 150 of Stafford's 228 passing yards. Stafford and the Rams play the Cardinals in Week 10, but his value may take a hit of Nacua (knee) misses time.

news.body: Matthew Stafford (elbow) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Washington Commanders.
news.head: Matthew Stafford (elbow) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: As expected, Stafford's elbow injury is nothing serious at this point and won't prevent him from playing on Sunday. He should be good to go, although he is harder to trust starting on a week-to-week basis now with several key pass catchers sidelined due to injury for the Rams.

news.body: Matthew Stafford was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Matthew Stafford (elbow) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: Stafford was reported to be dealing with elbow soreness. He should be a full-go for Sunday's game against the Commanders.

news.body: Rams coach Sean McVay told reporters Matthew Stafford has been dealing with soreness in his right elbow.
news.head: Matthew Stafford dealing with elbow soreness
news.impact: Staffford left the locker room on Sunday with a bag of ice wrapped to his right arm. He will need to be monitored in practice this week.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes II (knee/elbow) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II (knee/elbow) off injury report for Sunday
news.impact: Mahomes was dealing with a couple of different issues at practice throughout the week, but neither of them are serious and he is off of the injury report heading into Week 10. He will start and may be a worthy streaming option this week, although Kansas City's offense will struggle more if Kenneth Walker III (groin) is ruled out.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes II was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II (elbow) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Mahomes remains on track to be a full-go for Sunday's game against the Falcons.

news.body: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said he anticipates Patrick Mahomes II will practice in full on Wednesday.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II (elbow) expected to practice in full Wednesday
news.impact: Mahomes was day-to-day to start the week. Reid added that Mahomes was throwing the ball well despite his elbow injury.

news.body: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said Patrick Mahomes II is day-to-day.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II (elbow) considered day-to-day
news.impact: Reid said the news "was more positive than negative" on Mahomes and his elbow injury. He will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 16 of 26 passes for 242 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens. He also ran once for -1 yard.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence throws for 242 yards in rainy TNF
news.impact: Lawrence didn't have to do much to get his team the win in this game, much like Sunday when he faced the Colts. His one touchdown came on a breakaway play by Parker Washington, who was quiet aside from that play. Lawrence gets another easy matchup next week against the Titans. They will be well rested, however, as Tennessee is on a bye, but the Jaguars have a mini-bye themselves thanks to the Thursday game.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 10 of 14 passes for 210 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence torches Colts with only 10 completions
news.impact: It simply does not get much more efficient than Lawrence's performance Sunday afternoon.
