White is looking like a high-end RB3 in fantasy going forward as he heads into his bye in Week 7.

news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Lions.
news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Stevenson was expected to miss some time, but he was able to log back-to-back limited practices to end the week. He'll have a chance to play on Sunday.

news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) returned to practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) returns to limited practice Thursday
news.impact: Stevenson was able to make his return to practice on Thursday and was a limited participant. Early reports indicated that he was set to miss multiple weeks with this injury, but he seems to be recovering much quicker than expected and may miss little, if any, time. This is a situation worth monitoring heading into the weekend, as he will likely see the bulk of the work in New England's backfield if he's cleared to play in time for Sunday's game.

news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson was working off to the side during practice on Thursday.
news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) works off to side in practice Thursday
news.impact: Stevenson did not practice on Wednesday. He is trending in the wrong direction heading into Week 10.

news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson did not practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: Stevenson came out of Week 9 battling a knee tendon issue. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: Rico Dowdle ran for 56 yards and a touchdown on 15 carries in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
news.head: Rico Dowdle finds the end zone Sunday
news.impact: Dowdle saw a fairly decent role behind Jaylen Warren in Sunday's win. He'll be on the RB3 radar moving forward if his current role holds.

news.body: Rico Dowdle ran 9 times for 41 yards and caught all six of his targets for 45 yards in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints.
news.head: Rico Dowdle snags six passes in win
news.impact: Dowdle really saw his numbers come up in this game after a disappointing outing against Tampa Bay. Not that his efficiency running the ball was bad then, but he simply didn't receive many opportunities. Dowdle is looking like an RB3 type of play moving forward.

news.body: Rico Dowdle (knee) is officially active for Week 7 for the Pittsburgh Steelers against the New Orleans Saints according to Nick Farabaugh.
news.head: Rico Dowdle (knee) active for Week 7
news.impact: Dowdle will suit up after struggling through limited practice sessions late in the week, offering head coach Mike McCarthy another option out of the Pittsburgh backfield behind Jaylen Warren against the Saints.

news.body: Rico Dowdle (knee) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Rico Dowdle (knee) limited again Thursday
news.impact: The veteran running back was limited for another practice session on Thursday as he continues to manage a knee injury of some kind. He was able to play through it last week, however, so the expectation is that he will do the same again in Week 7.

news.body: Saquon Barkley rushed the ball 13 times for 22 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-11 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Saquon Barkley finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Barkley was able to get into the end zone once on Sunday, but he wasn't able to do anything outside of that. He finished with just 22 yards over the course of the game and didn't catch a single pass, which really hurt his fantasy total. He will be an unreliable starter for as long as Joe Milton III remains the starting quarterback for Philadelphia moving forward.

news.body: Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) is good to go for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
news.head: Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Barkley is still dealing with the nagging effects of a hamstring and back issue, but he carries no injury designation heading into the weekend and will play against the Giants. The team may still limit his workload, but he will continue to have explosive week-to-week upside every time he's on the field, even if that upside seems harder to attain now with Joe Milton III set to start at quarterback for the Eagles.

news.body: Saquon Barkley is practicing on Thursday.
news.head: Saquon Barkley practicing Thursday
news.impact: Barkley is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against his former team in the Giants. He'll remain on the RB2 radar for fantasy managers.

news.body: Saquon Barkley told reporters he was told by the Eagles that he would not be traded.
news.head: Saquon Barkley says he will not be traded
news.impact: Despite the Eagles falling to 2-6 on the season, it appears Barkley will not be going anywhere. There had been trade rumors of him potentially being moved before this year's deadline.

news.body: Tony Pollard (finger/rest) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Tony Pollard (finger/rest) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Pollard will be fully good to go for Week 10, despite missing Thursday's practice with a minor finger issue and as a rest day. He will see almost all of the work in Tennessee's backfield if Tyjae Spears (knee) is ruled out ahead of game time.

news.body: Tony Pollard (finger/rest) did not take part in Tennessee's practice on Thursday.
news.head: Tony Pollard (finger/rest) doesn't practice Thursday
news.impact: Pollard was held out of Tennessee's practice on Thursday. He's now listed with a finger issue of some kind, but it was also designated as a rest day, so it's unclear if that injury is anything to be concerned about. Friday's injury report should give us more information about what his game status will be for Week 10.

news.body: The Titans are not trading RB Tony Pollard.
news.head: Tony Pollard will not be traded
news.impact: Pollard will remain in Tennessee the rest of the season. He should remain a steady RB2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Tony Pollard carried the ball 21 times for 117 yards and two touchdowns while catching three of his five targets for 20 yards in a 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals in Week 8.
news.head: Tony Pollard stays hot with two TDs in Week 8
news.impact: Pollard found the end zone twice, on runs of one and 40 yards, giving him five rushing touchdowns over his past two contests. Overall, Pollard has rushed for 595 yards and six touchdowns in eight games. He is settling in as a solid RB2 in fantasy heading into his Week 9 bye.

news.body: Travis Etienne Jr. is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Panthers.
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Etienne was limited in practice to start the week before ending the week with a full practice. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

news.body: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) was limited at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) limited at practice Thursday
news.impact: Etienne has been out for most of the season with a hamstring issue, but he was able to return to practice on Wednesday and was limited for another practice session on Thursday. He could be back in the lineup this week, which would kill the fantasy value of Audric Estime and Alvin Kamara ahead of a plus matchup against the Panthers.

news.body: Travis Etienne Jr. had his practice window opened on Wednesday.
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) returns to practice Wednesday
news.impact: Etienne has been on injured reserve with a hamstring injury. He will have 21 days to be activated.

news.body: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) has been placed on injured reserve and will be out for at least four weeks.
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) placed on injured reserve
news.impact: The Saints have decided to place Etienne on injured reserve, which means that he is going to be sidelined for at least the next four weeks. He may be out longer than that as well, but the team has yet to place a concrete timetable on his recovery. Look for Alvin Kamara and Kendre Miller to both shoulder a much bigger workload in this backfield for the foreseeable future as a result of his absence.

news.body: TreVeyon Henderson has been ruled out for Week 10 against the Lions.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) ruled out for Week 10
news.impact: Henderson will remain sidelined due to an illness. He holds no clear timetable to return.

news.body: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) has been ruled out for Sunday’s contest between the New England Patriots and Green Bay Packers according to Evan Lazar.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) ruled out for Week 9
news.impact: Henderson will not suit while continuing to battle ongoing illness issues for head coach Mike Vrabel, with Rhamondre Stevenson once again expected to receive a sizeable workload out of the New England backfield against the Packers Sunday.

news.body: TreVeyon Henderson remained absent from practice on Thursday.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: Henderson is continuing to trend towards missing another game for the Patriots. He will need to be monitored in practice on Friday to end the week.

news.body: TreVeyon Henderson is not practicing on Wednesday.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) not practicing Wednesday
news.impact: Henderson did not play last week. He will need to continue to be monitored in practice on Thursday and Friday.

news.body: Tyjae Spears (knee) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Tyjae Spears (knee) questionable to play Sunday
news.impact: Spears was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Friday, but he's still uncertain to play in Week 10 and is officially questionable to play heading into the weekend. Tony Pollard will continue to have a monopoly on the backfield if the 25-year old is unable to play this week.

news.body: Tyjae Spears (knee) returned to practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
news.head: Tyjae Spears (knee) returns to practice Thursday
news.impact: Spears was a non-participant at practice on Wednesday, but he made his return on Thursday and was a limited participant. That's a good sign for his Week 10 availability, although we won't know his official status until later on in the week.

news.body: Tyjae Spears (knee) missed practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Tyjae Spears (knee) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: Spears was unable to practice on Wednesday. He has been dealing with this knee issue for a while, and it looks like the team's bye week wasn't enough to get him fully healthy. He's at risk of missing another game this week, which would lead to more work for Tony Pollard in Tennessee's backfield.

news.body: Tyjae Spears has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bengals.
news.head: Tyjae Spears (knee) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Spears missed practice all week. Tony Pollard will remain in a workhorse role.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier ran for 46 yards on 17 carries in the Cardinals 17-3 loss against the Seahawks. He also caught 2-of-3 targets for zero yards receiving.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier sees 17 carries Sunday
news.impact: With Jeremiyah Love on IR and Bam Knight in concussion protocol, Allgeier took over the workhorse role in the Cardinals backfield. He was the only running back to see a carry for Arizona. From a volume standpoint, he'll be an RB2 play next week against the Rams if Knight remains sidelined.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier carried the ball 11 times for 147 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in all five of his targets for 44 yards and one touchdown in the Cardinals' 33-30 Week 8 win over the Cowboys.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier dynamic in Week 8 win over Cowboys
news.impact: Allgeier took advantage of an Arizona backfield attack that lost Jeremiyah Love and Bam Knight, rushing for over 50 yards for the first time in his last seven contests. The running back could be in line for a sizeable workload if both Love and Knight remain sidelined for a Week 9 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier (toe) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Allgeier will return to his depth role with Jeremiyah Love slated to return.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier did not practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier (toe) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: Allgeier is dealing with a toe injury. Jeremiyah Love (ankle) returned to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday.

news.body: Woody Marks (knee) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
news.head: Woody Marks (knee) off injury report for Sunday
news.impact: Marks is set to be a full go on Sunday, despite managing a knee injury at practice throughout the week. He will only see enough work to be fantasy relevant if David Montgomery (groin) is ruled out ahead of game time, however.

news.body: Woody Marks returned to practice on Friday.
news.head: Woody Marks (knee) back at practice Friday
news.impact: Marks was absent from practice on Thursday. He should be on track to be ready to go for Sunday.

news.body: Woody Marks (knee) did not take part in Houston's practice on Thursday.
news.head: Woody Marks (knee) doesn't practice Thursday
news.impact: Marks suffered a knee injury in practice on Wednesday and wasn't able to practice on Thursday as a result. It looks like he's trending towards missing Week 10's matchup against the Browns, and if David Montgomery (groin) is also ruled out, fantasy managers should expect Emari Demercado and Dare Ogunbowale to both see more opportunities in his absence.

news.body: Woody Marks dealt with mild knee discomfort Wednesday in practice and didn't finish practice for precautionary reasons.
news.head: Woody Marks suffers knee injury in practice Wednesday, status uncertain
news.impact: Marks was not seen to begin practice on Thursday. He will need to be monitored on the official injury report.

news.body: Zach Charbonnet ran for 77 yards on 16 carries in the Seahawks 17-3 win over the Cardinals. He also caught 1-of-2 targets for nine yards receiving.
news.head: Zach Charbonnet runs for 77 yards Sunday
news.impact: Charbonnet looked much better in his second game back from injury. He has also had another impressive run called back due to a penalty. He should remain on the flex radar moving forward.

news.body: Zach Charbonnet rushed the ball six times for 23 yards and caught three passes for six yards in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Zach Charbonnet quiet in return game Monday
news.impact: Charbonnet made his season debut for the Seahawks on Monday night after missing an extended period of time recovering from a significant knee injury. He didn't make headlines in his first game back, however, racking up just 29 total yards on his nine touches over the course of the night. He will likely continue to get more involved as he continues to ramp back up to a full workload over the next couple of weeks.

news.body: Zach Charbonnet is off the injury report for Monday's game against the Bears.
news.head: Zach Charbonnet (knee) off injury report Monday
news.impact: Charbonnet will be ready to make his season debut. He'll be a touchdown dependent flex play in his first game back for fantasy managers.

news.body: Zach Charbonnet was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Zach Charbonnet (knee) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: Charbonnet remains hopeful to make his season debut on Monday against the Bears.

news.body: AJ Barner caught 2-of-4 targets for seven yards and a touchdown in the Seahawks 17-3 win over the Cardinals. He also added a rushing touchdown.
news.head: AJ Barner totals two touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Barner got the Seahawks on the board with a "BarnYard" at the goal line. He later had a controversial touchdown catch where it appeared the ball may have hit the ground, but the refs had the call on the field stand. He remains a touchdown dependent TE2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: AJ Barner caught 2-of-5 targets for 23 yards in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: AJ Barner catches two passes Monday
news.impact: Barner was targeted five times on Monday night, but he was only able to turn that into two catches for 23 yards. He remains off of the fantasy radar for the foreseeable future.

news.body: AJ Barner caught four of his five targets for 42 yards in a 20-3 win over the Chiefs in Week 7.
news.head: AJ Barner goes for 42 yards in Week 7
news.impact: Barner finished second on the Seahawks in targets, catches, and receiving in the impressive win against the previously undefeated Chiefs. The veteran tight end has 19 catches for 180 yards and zero touchdowns through seven games this year. He will be a TE2 in fantasy in Week 8 vs. the Bears.

news.body: AJ Barner caught three of four targets for 16 yards in the Seahawks' 17-14 loss to the Broncos on Thursday.
news.head: AJ Barner catches three passes in loss
news.impact: Barner hasn't really gotten going this season after showing a lot of promise in 2025. The ability is there; we saw it back in Week 3 against Washington, but the opportunity hasn't been. He's not startable in fantasy right now.

news.body: Brenton Strange caught both of his targets for 22 yards in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Brenton Strange goes for 22 yards in win
news.impact: It was a bit of a letdown after Strange had been successful in the last few weeks as a streaming tight end play. Nate Boerkircher has started to get more involved in recent weeks, and that could be limiting Strange's upside.

news.body: Brenton Strange caught both of his targets for 55 yards in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
news.head: Brenton Strange goes for 55 receiving yards on Sunday
news.impact: Strange had the longest gain of his career Sunday, as he went 46 yards on QB Trevor Lawrence's first pass of the game. Lawrence only completed 10 passes in this contest, so Strange and the rest of the Jaguars route runners didn't deliver huge production for fantasy managers. In fact, Strange was one of three Jaguars to tie for the team lead in receptions. He also tied running back Bhayshul Tuten for the team lead in receiving yards. Strange is having a solid season, but the Jaguars run a largely balanced attack, with Lawrence spreading the ball around to a variety of targets.

news.body: Brenton Strange (eye) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Brenton Strange (eye) cleared to play Sunday
news.impact: Strange has been listed on the injury report throughout the week due to a minor eye issue, but it won't stop him from playing in a full capacity in Week 8. He may see more work than usual if Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) is ruled out against the Colts.

news.body: Brenton Strange was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Brenton Strange (eye) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Strange will be good to go for Sunday's game against the Colts. He remains in the low-end TE1 range for fantasy managers.

news.body: Brock Bowers caught 7-of-8 targets for 111 yards and a touchdown in the Raiders 38-17 loss against the 49ers.
news.head: Brock Bowers continues to dominate Sunday
news.impact: Bowers remains the most consistent part of the Raiders offense on a week-to-week basis. He did lose a fumble on the day, but otherwise had another big day for fantasy managers.

news.body: Brock Bowers caught 7-of-10 targets for 92 yards and a two touchdowns in a 38-33 win over the Jets.
news.head: Brock Bowers finds the end zone twice in Week 8 win
news.impact: Bowers found the end zone in the first and third quarters and just missed on another touchdown in which he was tackled at the one. Bowers has recorded at least 70 receiving yards in six straight games, marking the first time that feat has been accomplished by a tight end in NFL history. Bowers and the Raiders will take on the 49ers in Week 9.

news.body: Brock Bowers was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Brock Bowers (calf) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Warren notes that Bowers was also limited last Wednesday then was a full participant in practice the next two days.

news.body: Brock Bowers caught six of his eight targets for 73 yards in the Raiders' 35-21 Week 7 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Brock Bowers catches six passes in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Bowers has made the most of his opportunities in an inconsistent passing attack, finishing with 70 or more receiving yards in each of his five contests. The tight end remains one of the more reliable-pass catching options in the Raiders offense ahead of a Week 8 contest against the New York Jets.

news.body: Chig Okonkwo caught four of his eight targets for 24 yards in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.
news.head: Chig Okonkwo catches four passes in TNF win
news.impact: Okonkwo finished second on the team in targets despite missing some time during the game with a back issue. He was able to return to the game after getting the injury checked out, but fellow tight end Ben Sinnott caught a touchdown pass during his absence. Okonkwo now has 27 catches for 263 yards through seven contests. He will look for his first TD of the season in Week 11 vs. the Cincinnati Bengals.

news.body: Chig Okonkwo had seven receptions for 57 yards in Sunday's loss to the Rams.
news.head: Chig Okonkwo goes 7/57 in loss
news.impact: Chig led his team in receptions and put together a respectable performance for the struggling Commanders. Okonkwo will be in the high-end TE2 range for TNF against the Giants.

news.body: Chig Okonkwo caught two of his four targets for 32 yards and lost a fumble in a 27-10 win over the Eagles in Week 8.
news.head: Chig Okonkwo catches two balls in Week 8
news.impact: Okonkwo was quiet despite the Commanders playing their first game without Terry McLaurin. The veteran tight end will look to bounce back in Week 9 vs. the Rams. He can be treated as a TE2 in fantasy for that matchup.

news.body: Chig Okonkwo caught all seven of his targets for 69 yards in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6.
news.head: Chig Okonkwo goes for seven catches, 69 yards in Week 6
news.impact: Okonkwo led the Commanders in receiving in the close loss on Monday night. The veteran tight end has caught at least four passes while reaching at least 60 yards in two straight games. He could be in store for a larger role after his bye in Week 7, as Terry McLaurin was carted off the field on Monday vs. the 49ers with a knee injury.

news.body: Colby Parkinson (ribs) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Colby Parkinson (ribs) off injury report for Sunday
news.impact: Parkinson was limited at practice earlier in the week due to an injury to his ribs, but he was able to log a full practice session on Friday and is now off of the injury report heading into the weekend. He should be a full go against the Cardinals.

news.body: Colby Parkinson was limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Colby Parkinson (ribs) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Parkinson is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Cardinals. The tight ends should see more involvement in the passing game for the Rams with their wide receiver room depleted.

news.body: Colby Parkinson had four receptions for 13 yards in Sunday's win over the Commanders.
news.head: Colby Parkinson goes 4/13 in return
news.impact: Parkinson had the second-most receptions on his team, but had the lowest receiving output. Parkinson is a touchdown-dependent TE2 for Week 10’s matchup against the Cardinals.

news.body: Rams TE Colby Parkinson (ribs) is officially active for a Week 9 matchup with Washington.
news.head: Colby Parkinson (ribs) officially active for Week 9
news.impact: Parkinson was considered questionable to play after logging just one limited practice session. He will likely see plenty of snaps, with Tyler Higbee and Davis Allen also figuring to factor into the rotation at tight end.

news.body: Colston Loveland caught four of his six targets for 54 yards in a 27-24 win over the Buccaneers in Week 9.
news.head: Colston Loveland catches four passes in Week 9
news.impact: Loveland was quiet for most of the evening, catching two passes for 44 yards on the team's final drive of the game. The second-year tight end has caught 37 passes for 363 yards and two touchdowns in nine games this year. A low-end TE1 in fantasy, Loveland will be on bye in Week 10.

news.body: Colston Loveland hauled in 7-of-9 targets for 65 yards in Monday night's 34-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: Colston Loveland catches seven passes Monday
news.impact: Loveland saw good involvement on Monday night. He was tied for the most targets and receptions out of anyone on the team, and he was able to turn his seven catches into 65 yards against the Seahawks. Fantasy managers should feel good about his chances at a breakout over the back half of the season.

news.body: Bears TE Colston Loveland was removed from the injury report for Monday's game against the Seahawks.
news.head: Colston Loveland (neck) removed from injury report for Week 8
news.impact: Loveland was added to the injury report on Friday. He will be good to go in a tough matchup against Seattle.

news.body: Colston Loveland was limited in practice on Friday.
news.head: Colston Loveland (neck) limited in practice Friday
news.impact: Loveland was a late addition to the injury report. He will need to be monitored in practice on Saturday heading into Monday's game against the Seahawks.

news.body: Dallas Goedert caught 5-of-6 targets for 50 yards in Sunday's 19-11 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Dallas Goedert solid in loss Sunday
news.impact: The veteran finished with a solid 50 yards on five catches, but he didn't get into the end zone at all, which left him with a fantasy total that was just okay. He isn't a great fantasy option at this point in the season with how bad Philadelphia's offense has looked recently.

news.body: Dallas Goedert caught all four of his targets for 30 yards in a 27-10 loss to the Commanders in Week 8.
news.head: Dallas Goedert catches four balls in Week 8
news.impact: Goedert finished third on the team in receiving in the loss to Washington on Sunday night. The veteran tight end now has 26 catches for 258 yards and two touchdowns in six games this season. He will be a low-end TE1 in Week 9 vs. the Giants.

news.body: Dallas Goedert hauled in 5-of-7 targets for 48 yards in Monday night's 38-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
news.head: Dallas Goedert hauls in five passes Monday
news.impact: The veteran played pretty well on Monday. He hauled in five passes over the course of the game and was able to turn that into 48 yards, but he didn't get into the end zone at all, which left him with a mediocre fantasy finish in most league formats. He will likely continue to be startable moving forward, especially if DeVonta Smith (hamstring) misses more time.

news.body: Dallas Goedert (knee) is not taking part in Philadelphia's practice on Friday.
news.head: Dallas Goedert (knee) not practicing Friday
news.impact: The veteran tight end is not practicing for the Eagles again on Friday. He will have one more chance to log at least a limited practice on Saturday before the team's game on Monday night, but if he's not able to, it's likely that he will be sidelined for the team's primetime matchup against Dallas in Week 7.

news.body: Dalton Kincaid was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Dalton Kincaid (ankle) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Kincaid is managing an ankle issue. He should still be good to go for Week 10.

news.body: Dalton Kincaid hauled in all three of his targets for 28 yards in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Dalton Kincaid catches three passes in Week 9 win
news.impact: Kincaid's up-and-down campaign continued Monday night. The fourth-year TE has pretty much become a feast-or-famine fantasy option at this point. Proceed accordingly.

news.body: Dalton Kincaid caught 4-of-6 targets for 86 yards and a touchdown in a 36-10 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Dalton Kincaid hits pay dirt in Week 8 win
news.impact: Kincaid led the team in receiving yards and found the end zone on a 23-yard reception late in the fourth quarter. Kincaid has seen his target share increase over the last two weeks, logging at least six in consecutive games. Kincaid and the Bills will take on the Vikings in Week 9.

news.body: Dalton Kincaid (chest) is officially active for Week 8 for the Buffalo Bills against the Baltimore Ravens according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Dalton Kincaid (chest) active for Week 8
news.impact: Kincaid will take the field after passing through pregame warmups without any setbacks, offering quarterback Josh Allen one of his more impactful red zone weapons against the Ravens Sunday.

news.body: Dalton Schultz caught 2-of-4 targets for 42 yards in Sunday's 44-22 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Dalton Schultz catches two passes Sunday
news.impact: Schultz didn't see a lot of involvement on Sunday, finishing with just two catches in a win over the Chargers. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to be super reliable on a week-to-week basis moving forward, though hew will continue to have value as a streaming option.

news.body: Dalton Schultz caught 5-of-6 targets for 45 yards in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
news.head: Dalton Schultz hauls in five passes Sunday
news.impact: Schultz was the safety blanket for C.J. Stroud on the day. He remains a borderline low-end TE1/high-end TE2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Dalton Schultz (quad) is good to go for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
news.head: Dalton Schultz (quad) good to go Sunday
news.impact: The veteran was dealing with a quad injury at practice throughout the week, but it's not a serious issue at this point and won't prevent him from playing in Week 7. He will continue to be a decent week-to-week streaming option in PPR formats moving forward.

news.body: Dalton Schultz (quad) returned to practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
news.head: Dalton Schultz (quad) returns to practice Thursday
news.impact: Schultz was back at practice on Thursday after missing Wednesday's practice due to a quad issue. It looks like he will play in Week 7, assuming he doesn't suffer any setbacks at practice throughout the rest of the week.

news.body: Darnell Washington caught 3-of-5 targets for 94 yards in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Steelers.
news.head: Darnell Washington turns in big gain Sunday
news.impact: Washington found himself wide open for a catch and run of 58 yards. He has his flashes, but he still remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Darnell Washington caught his only target for a four-yard touchdown in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints.
news.head: Darnell Washington brings in touchdown in win
news.impact: Washington now has a touchdown grab in three of the last four games. He's going to continue to be a reliable option down near the goal line, but don't expect a lot of volume most weeks. He's a touchdown-or-bust option.

news.body: Darnell Washington caught 4-of-6 targets for 25 yards and a touchdown in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers.
news.head: Darnell Washington finds the end zone Sunday
news.impact: Washington saw some more opportunity with Pat Freiermuth dealing with a calf injury. He'll remain a touchdown dependent TE2 heading into next week.

news.body: Darnell Washington caught 3-of-5 targets for 27 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
news.head: Darnell Washington hits paydirt in Week 4 loss
news.impact: Washington scored for the first time this season in Thursday's game. The towering TE has been productive in each of the last two games, hauling in six passes for 94 yards. He's still a risky fantasy option, with QB Aaron Rodgers spreading the ball around to a plethora of receivers.

news.body: Darren Waller caught eight of 10 targets for 90 yards and one touchdown in the Panthers' 26-21 loss to the Broncos in Week 9.
news.head: Darren Waller totals 90 yards and touchdown in Week 9
news.impact: Waller scored from 15 yards out in the third quarter to give Carolina a 14-13 lead. He also led the Panthers in receptions, targets, and receiving yards. That's a significant improvement from his one-catch, 11-yard performance in Week 8. Waller was Bryce Young's primary receiving option Sunday and has the production to warrant consideration as a fantasy starter against the Saints in Week 10.

news.body: Darren Waller caught 1-of-2 targets for 11 yards in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
news.head: Darren Waller finishes with only one reception Thursday night
news.impact: Waller now has just two catches on a total of six targets over the last three weeks. Unlike in Week 7, when he scored on a 50-yard gain, the veteran TE was limited to just 11 yards in Week 8. Early on this season, it looked like Waller would be a significant contributor for the Panthers. That has now faded.

news.body: Darren Waller caught one of two targets for a 50-yard touchdown in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to the Buccaneers on Sunday,
news.head: Darren Waller catches long TD in loss to Tampa
news.impact: If you have to only catch one ball, you might as well make it count. Waller rewarded those who started him with a long 50-yard score before going silent for the rest of the way. He's a risky start in fantasy despite some initial optimism for his role,

news.body: Carolina Panthers tight end Darren Waller did not record a reception on two targets in a Week 6 win over Philadelphia.
news.head: Darren Waller blanked in Week 6
news.impact: Waller's two targets were his fewest since Week 1. He had 14 between Weeks 3 and 4 heading into a Week 5 bye, but tight end Tommy Tremble got involved with two touchdowns in Week 6. The Panthers' offense has been potent, but Tremble has been involved as well with 11 catches in the last three games.

news.body: Eli Raridon caught 3-of-6 targets for 52 yards in Sunday's 45-27 loss to the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Eli Raridon racks up 52 yards Sunday
news.impact: The rookie was able to contribute well on Sunday, contributing 52 yards in the team's loss to the Packers. He finished with a better game than veteran Hunter Henry, and every week it seems like Raridon continues to establish himself as an increasingly important member of this offense. He should be a worthwhile streaming option over the back half of the season.

news.body: Eli Raridon caught one of four targets for five yards in the Patriots' 24-19 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
news.head: Eli Raridon quiet in win over Dolphins
news.impact: Not counting throwaways, Raridon was the intended target on all of Drake Maye's incompletions on Sunday. Do with that what you will, but either way, it was not the best game for the rookie. He will have better days, and on the bright side, this means he has had 4+ targets in three of his last four games.

news.body: Eli Raridon secured 3-of-4 targets for 56 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 30-24 loss to the Bears.
news.head: Eli Raridon hits paydirt in Week 7
news.impact: Raridon emerged during a five-catch performance back in Week 5. He almost disappeared in Week 6, but the rookie third-rounder stepped back up Thursday night. Raridon scored his second career TD on a 30-yard strike from QB Drake Maye in the third quarter of this one, and he's certainly a talented young player for fantasy managers to keep tabs on.

news.body: Eli Raridon caught all five of his targets for 57 yards in the Patriots 45-17 win over the Raiders.
news.head: Eli Raridon hauls in five passes in Week 5 win
news.impact: Raridon set new season highs in receptions, targets, and receiving yards in the win over Las Vegas. The rookie continues to see Hunter Henry see the bulk of the snaps, but Raridon is carving out a role after the first five weeks of the season.

news.body: George Kittle caught 4-of-7 targets for 58 yards in the 49ers 38-17 win over the Raiders.
news.head: George Kittle totals 58 yards Sunday
news.impact: Kittle led the Niners with seven targets. Brock Purdy attempted just 25 passes on the day. Kittle will remain a TE1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: George Kittle hauled in 8-of-10 targets for 88 yards in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
news.head: George Kittle leads 49ers in receiving Sunday
news.impact: With both Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel out, Kittle put up new season highs in receptions, targets, and receiving yards on Sunday. The veteran TE is averaging just under five grabs for more than 60 yards per game with five touchdowns through seven weeks. Kittle remains among the top fantasy assets at TE.

news.body: George Kittle caught five of his eight targets for 69 yards and a touchdown in a 23-17 win over the Commanders in Week 6.
news.head: George Kittle finds the end zone in Week 6
news.impact: Kittle finished second on the 49ers in receiving yards and catches in the close win on Monday night. The veteran tight end scored his touchdown on an 11-yard pass from Brock Purdy early in the first quarter. Overall, Kittle has 26 catches for 337 yards and five touchdowns through six games for the 49ers. With Mike Evans (Achilles soreness) expected to be held out through the team's Week 8 bye, Kittle will be a top-five fantasy tight end option in Week 7 vs. the Falcons.

news.body: George Kittle caught 5-of-6 targets for 24 yards in the 49ers 32-29 win over the Seahawks.
news.head: George Kittle catches five passes Sunday
news.impact: Kittle was used as a dump off pass catcher from Brock Purdy all afternoon. He'll look to bounce back next week against the Commanders.

news.body: Greg Dulcich caught two of his four targets for 14 yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 Week 9 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Greg Dulcich catches two passes in Week 9 loss
news.impact: Dulcich has seen increased involvement in the Miami passing attack of late, logging four or more targets in each of his last four contests. The tight end remains one of many risky pass-catching options in the Miami offense ahead of a Week 10 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts.

news.body: Greg Dulcich caught four of six targets for 43 yards in the Dolphins' 24-19 loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Greg Dulcich snags four passes in loss to Pats
news.impact: Funny enough, he had the exact same receiving line as Caleb Douglas, who also had four receptions on six targets for 43 yards. Not only that, but just to mention it for fun, the game's total was 43 points, and the average receiving yards of Miami's top four receivers in this game was 43. Do with that information what you choose, but either way, Dulcich has been on the rise recently, with 5+ targets and 37+ receiving yards in each of the last three games. Not only that, but next week he gets the Lions, who have been one of the best matchups for tight ends so far this year.

news.body: Greg Dulcich is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Patriots.
news.head: Greg Dulcich (ankle) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Dulcich will remain a TE2 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Greg Dulcich was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Greg Dulcich (ankle) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Dulcich will remain a TE2 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Texans.
news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Fannin will remain a TE1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) limited again Thursday
news.impact: Fannin was limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday. He's still managing a groin issue, but it doesn't seem to be a major threat to his Week 10 availability. Fantasy managers shouldn't hesitate to start him if he's active this week.

news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Fannin is on track to be good to go in Week 10 for the Browns. He remains a TE1 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. caught both of his targets for 42 yards and a score in the Browns' 23-22 OT loss to the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. snags touchdown in loss to Saints
news.impact: Fannin was quiet for most of this game, but came through for fantasy managers with a 39-yard touchdown in overtime. For fantasy purposes, Fannin's on a hot streak and needs to be in lineups.

news.body: Hunter Henry is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Lions.
news.head: Hunter Henry (foot) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Henry was limited in practice all week. He will remain a borderline TE1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Hunter Henry (foot) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Hunter Henry (foot) limited again Thursday
news.impact: Henry was again limited on Thursday. He has been dealing with this foot issue for a little while now, but he was able to play through it last week and seems likely to do so again this week. He could be worth starting in Week 10, as this matchup against the Lions is expected to be a high-scoring affair.

news.body: Hunter Henry was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Hunter Henry (foot) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Henry played through the injury last week. He should be on track to be good to go in Week 10.

news.body: Hunter Henry caught three passes for 35 yards in Sunday's 45-27 loss to the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Hunter Henry catches three passes Sunday
news.impact: Surprisingly, Henry was able to play on Sunday after being listed on the team's injury report with a foot issue. He looked okay in this game but was only able to rack up 35 scoreless yards over the course of the afternoon, which left him with an underwhelming fantasy total. He may not be as good as usual moving forward if rookie Eli Raridon continues to improve and establish himself as a key part of this offense.

news.body: Isaiah Likely caught nine of his 11 targets for 127 yards and one touchdown in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10.
news.head: Isaiah Likely explodes for 127 yards, one TD in Week 10
news.impact: Likely turned in a huge outing in the loss to Washington on Thursday night. He did most of his damage on a 66-yard TD catch from J.J. McCarthy in the fourth quarter. Likely's impressive first season with the Giants continues as he now has 55 catches for 575 yards and seven touchdowns in nine games. He will be a locked-in TE1 in fantasy in Week 11 vs. the Jaguars.

news.body: Isaiah Likely hauled in 5-of-6 targets for 53 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-11 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Isaiah Likely hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Likely was able to finish with a good stat line on Sunday. He racked up 53 yards and was able to get into the end zone at one point, which left him with a good fantasy total on the day. He should continue to be started moving forward, though he is prone to having a bad game here or there with how New York's is currently being operated.

news.body: Isaiah Likely caught 2-of-4 targets for 12 yards in the Giants 27-21 win over the Giants.
news.head: Isaiah Likely quiet Sunday
news.impact: Likely was not involved much in the first career start for J.J. McCarthy. He still remains a TE1 heading into the Giants bye week.

news.body: Isaiah Likely caught 6-of-11 targets for 99 yards and a touchdown in the Giants 34-27 loss against the Saints.
news.head: Isaiah Likely hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Likely continued his success at finding the end zone. He nearly caught a second one as J.J. McCarthy just missed looking to find him to tie the game at the end of the game. He remains a locked in TE1.

news.body: Juwan Johnson caught both of his targets for 34 yards and a touchdown in the Saints' 23-22 win over the Browns on Sunday.
news.head: Juwan Johnson snags touchdown in win over Browns
news.impact: Johnson had struggled to get much of anything going over the last few weeks, and Sunday was much the same aside from a touchdown that saved his fantasy day. He might have some better luck moving foward, but he's best left on the bench for now.

news.body: Juwan Johnson caught just one of three targets for seven yards in the Saints' 16-10 loss to the Steelers on Sunday,
news.head: Juwan Johnson held in check on Sunday
news.impact: Johnson started the season off hot, but has only five catches for 23 yards in the past three weeks, with four of those receptions and 16 of the yards coming in one game. With Jordyn Tyson expected to return after the bye, Johnson could find himself buried even further.

news.body: Juwan Johnson did not catch either of his two targets in the Saints 34-27 win over the Giants.
news.head: Juwan Johnson does not haul in pass Sunday
news.impact: It was a low-volume passing day for New Orleans. Johnson will look to bounce back next week against the Steelers.

news.body: Juwan Johnson caught four of his five targets for 16 yards in the Saints' 23-13 loss to the Minnesota Vikings in Week 5.
news.head: Juwan Johnson quiet in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Johnson struggled to make an impact against a tough Minnesota defense, finishing with under 50 receiving yards for the first time in five contests. The tight end will look to get back on track against the New York Giants in Week 6.

news.body: Kyle Pitts Sr. caught 3-of-5 targets for 23 yards in a 34-17 loss to the Bengals.
news.head: Kyle Pitts Sr. hauls in three passes in Week 9
news.impact: Pitts has seen a steady volume of targets, logging at least five in five straight games. Despite that, Pitts has not eclipsed more than 23 yards in any of his last three games. Pitts andn the Falcons will take on the Chiefs in Week 10.

news.body: Kyle Pitts Sr. caught 2-of-5 targets for six yards in the Falcons 16-0 loss against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Kyle Pitts Sr. quiet Sunday
news.impact: It was a week to forget for the entire Falcons offense. He will remain a TE2 play next week against the Bengals.

news.body: Kyle Pitts Sr. hauled in all five of his targets for 22 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
news.head: Kyle Pitts Sr. hits paydirt again in Week 7 win
news.impact: For those who were patient with Pitts after a very slow start this season, the rewards have come over the last three weeks. The towering tight end has now scored four times during that span, catching exactly five passes each time out.

news.body: Kyle Pitts Sr. hauled in five of his seven targets for 60 yards and two touchdowns in the Falcons' 31-23 Week 6 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Kyle Pitts Sr. hauls in two touchdowns in Week 6 loss to Bears
news.impact: Pitts Sr. has made the most of the return of quarterback Michael Penix Jr., recording five receptions and one or more touchdowns in each of the last two contests. The tight end remains one of the primary pass-catching options for head coach Kevin Stefanski as long as Penix Jr. is behind center ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught both of his targets for 11 yards in a 34-17 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Mike Gesicki hauls in two passes in Week 9
news.impact: Gesicki had a streak of five straight games with a touchdown snapped Sunday. The veteran tight end had not logged a lot of receptions, but had provided fantasy managers with plenty of trips to the end zone. Gesicki and the Bengals will take on the Steelers in Week 10.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught four of his six targets for 76 yards and a touchdown in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Mike Gesicki catches TD in Week 8
news.impact: Gesicki had a big afternoon in the Bengals' first game since losing Erick All to a torn ACL. He has now caught a touchdown in all six of his games played this season. Gesicki will be a high-end TE2 in Week 9 vs. the Falcons.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught his lone target for six yards and a touchdown in a 35-13 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Mike Gesicki hits pay dirt in Week 7
news.impact: Gesicki found the end zone in the third quarter to open the scoring for the Bengals on their way to a comeback win. The veteran tight end has five touchdowns in six games so far this season. Gesicki and the Bengals will take on the Titans in Week 8.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught 1-of-2 targets for four yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Mike Gesicki finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Gesicki was pretty uninvolved on Sunday in general, but he was able to leave his mark on the game by connecting with QB Joe Burrow on a short four-yard touchdown. He still didn't end with a good fantasy total, however, and should not be started in most leagues moving forward.

news.body: Pat Freiermuth caught 2-of-2 targets for 35 yards in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth scores touchdown on ground Sunday
news.impact: Freiermuth scored a touchdown at the goal line on a tush push. His upside remains limited as a pass catcher. He is a touchdown dependent TE2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Pat Freiermuth caught two of four targets for 20 yards in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth held to two catches in win
news.impact: After two games with a combined three touchdowns, Freiermuth has just four receptions for 31 yards in the last two games. He's a risky streaming tight end at best.

news.body: Pat Freiermuth caught 2-of-3 targets for 11 yards in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth quiet Sunday
news.impact: Freiermuth was playing through a calf injury that landed him on the injury report right before Sunday. He'll be more reliable if he can practice fully next week.

news.body: Steelers TE Pat Freiermuth (calf) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with Tampa Bay.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth (calf) officially active for Week 6
news.impact: Freiermuth was a late addition to the injury report this week, but has been cleared to play after pregame warmups. The veteran has appeared more involved in the offense as of late, scoring three touchdowns in his last two games.

news.body: The Lions have reportedly received calls on TE Sam LaPorta.
news.head: Sam LaPorta receiving trade interest, not expected to be moved
news.impact: Fowler notes that teams have gotten the impression that Detroit "would like to keep him and try to work out a long-terms deal eventually." It appears LaPorta is likely to remain in Detroit long-term.

news.body: Sam LaPorta hauled in four of his five targets for 32 yards in the Lions' 19-9 Week 9 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Sam LaPorta sees five targets in Week 9 win
news.impact: LaPorta remains consistently involved in the Detroit passing attack of late, recording five or more targets in four of his last five contests. The tight end remains one of the more stable pass-catching options as part of a prolific Detroit offense heading into a Week 10 matchup against the New England Patriots.

news.body: Sam LaPorta caught three of his five targets for 33 yards while also rushing once for two yards in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings in Week 8.
news.head: Sam LaPorta quiet in Week 8 win
news.impact: LaPorta has struggled to make an impact on offense of late, recording less than 35 receiving yards in each of his last two contests. The tight end will look to get back on track against an underwhelming Miami Dolphins defense in Week 9.

news.body: Sam LaPorta caught 1-of-2 targets for just 18 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Sam LaPorta disappoints in win Sunday
news.impact: LaPorta had a disappointing performance on Sunday. He was only able to catch one pass over the course of the entire game, and he was only able to rack up 18 scoreless yards on it, which left him with a poor fantasy total. He should bounce back in the near future, though he will remain prone to bad showings in the future.

news.body: Terrance Ferguson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
news.head: Terrance Ferguson (ankle/hamstring) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Ferguson will remain sidelined as expected after he re-aggravated his hamstring injury last week.

news.body: Terrance Ferguson remained absent from practice on Thursday.
news.head: Terrance Ferguson (ankle/hamstring) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: Ferguson is on track to remain sidelined for Sunday's game against the Cardinals for the Rams.

news.body: Terrance Ferguson did not practice in Wednesday’s walk-through.
news.head: Terrance Ferguson (ankle/hamstring) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: Rams head coach Sean McVay said earlier this week that Ferguson is likely out a couple weeks after re-aggravating his hamstring injury last week.

news.body: Rams head coach Sean McVay said Terrance Ferguson pulled his hamstring during practice on Friday and will likely be out for "another couple [of] weeks."
news.head: Terrance Ferguson (hamstring) to miss a couple of weeks
news.impact: Ferguson was originally removed from the injury report last Friday before he was later ruled out. McVay said Ferguson was going to be a "big part" of the gameplan on Sunday.

news.body: T.J. Hockenson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Packers.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson (wrist/chest) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Hockenson was unable to get healthy enough in time on a short week.

news.body: T.J. Hockenson did not practice on Thursday.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson (wrist/chest) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: Hockenson missed a second straight practice on a short week. He will need to be monitored in practice on Friday.

news.body: T.J. Hockenson did not practice on Wednesday.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson (wrist/chest) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: Hockenson appears to have suffered the injuries in Monday's loss against the Bills. He will need to be monitored in practice on a short week.

news.body: T.J. Hockenson caught 4-of-7 targets for 33 yards in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson hauls in four passes Monday night
news.impact: Hockenson actually led the Vikings in receptions Monday night, but the offense was pretty much shut down on the whole. The veteran TE has had a decent season to this point despite lacking QB play for the Vikings. Hockenson had scored in two straight games going into Monday night, and he's now caught four passes in three consecutive weeks.

news.body: Travis Kelce (ankle) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Travis Kelce (ankle) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: As expected, Kelce was able to practice all week and will be good to go for Sunday's game against the Falcons. He will continue to be a safe PPR option on a week-to-week basis, though his ceiling isn't all that high at this point in his career.

news.body: Travis Kelce is practicing in full for Sunday's game against the Falcons.
news.head: Travis Kelce (ankle) practicing in full for Week 10
news.impact: Kelce will remain a borderline TE1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Travis Kelce caught 4-of-6 targets for 72 yards in a 35-12 win over the Jets. He rushed for a one-yard touchdown as well.
news.head: Travis Kelce finds the end zone in Week 9 win
news.impact: Kelce lead the team in receiving yards and found the end zone on a one-yard backwards pass in the third quarter. His 72 receiving yards are the most he has logged since a 101 yard performance in Week 2. Kelce and the Chiefs will take on the Falcons in Week 10.

news.body: Travis Kelce (ankle) was limited at Kansas City's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Travis Kelce (ankle) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: The veteran was limited for the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday. He's still managing an ankle issue of some kind, but it isn't likely to leave him sidelined in Week 9. He will continue to be a decently safe PPR option on a week-to-week basis moving forward.

news.body: Trey McBride caught 7-of-8 targets for 54 yards in the Cardinals 17-3 loss against the Seahawks.
news.head: Trey McBride hauls in seven passes Sunday
news.impact: McBride nearly hauled in a touchdown late in the loss, but the pass was knocked away by Nick Emmanwori late in the fourth quarter. McBride remains a locked and loaded elite high-end TE1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Trey McBride hauled in seven of his eight targets for 72 yards and one touchdown in the Cardinals' 33-30 Week 8 win over the Cowboys.
news.head: Trey McBride finds end zone in Week 8 win over Cowboys
news.impact: McBride has had a nose for the end zone of late, recording a receiving touchdown in three of his last four contests. The tight end remains locked in as a reliable TE1 option ahead of a Week 9 matchup against a tough Seattle Seahawks defense in Week 9.

news.body: Trey McBride caught 10 of 13 targets for 111 yards and one touchdown in the Cardinals' 30-16 loss to the Broncos in Week 7.
news.head: Trey McBride Goes Over 100 Yards, Scores in Week 7
news.impact: McBride accounted for 10 of Jacoby Brissett's 27 completions and 111 of his 272 passing yards. He also caught Arizona's only touchdown, scoring from seven yards out in the third quarter. With 13 targets and no other Cardinal seeing more than eight, McBride remains one of fantasy football's safest elite TE1 options.

news.body: Trey McBride hauled in 7-of-9 targets for 53 yards in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Trey McBride leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: McBride continues to produce well in PPR scoring formats, hauling in seven passes in Sunday's upset win over the Rams. He wasn't able to turn those seven catches into much, but fantasy managers should still be satisfied with the performance that he put up.

news.body: Tucker Kraft caught one of his three targets for one yard while also rushing twice for eight yards in the Packers' 45-27 Week 9 win over the Patriots.
news.head: Tucker Kraft quiet in Week 9 win
news.impact: Kraft fell back to earth in Sunday's win, being held to less than four receptions for the first time in seven contests. The tight end will look to get back on track against a tough Minnesota Vikings defense in Week 10.

news.body: Tucker Kraft secured all six of his targets for 53 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 27-19 win over the Panthers.
news.head: Tucker Kraft scores again in Week 8
news.impact: Kraft scored for the second consecutive game and the third time this season in Thursday night's win. The fourth-year TE has now caught between 4-6 passes in six straight weeks, and though he hasn't gone over 65 yards in any game this season, Kraft remains a solid TE1.

news.body: Tucker Kraft hauled in 4-of-6 targets for 49 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Tucker Kraft finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Kraft had a solid game on Sunday. He was able to haul in four passes for 49 yards on the afternoon, one of which he was able to get into the end zone on as well. He should continue to be viewed as a weekly starter at the tight end position moving forward.

news.body: Tucker Kraft caught five of his eight targets for 37 yards in a 23-13 win over the Cowboys in Week 6.
news.head: Tucker Kraft catches five passes in Week 6
news.impact: Kraft finished tied for second on the team in targets but was able to manage just 37 yards in the win. The veteran tight end now has 25 catches for 249 yards and one touchdown in six games for the Packers this year. He will be a strong TE1 in Week 7 vs. the Lions.

news.body: Tyler Higbee (illness) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Tyler Higbee (illness) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Higbee has recovered from the illness that was bothering him earlier in the week and will be good to go for Sunday's game. He hasn't been productive lately but will have a chance to step up and see more work on an injury-riddled Rams' offense in Week 10.

news.body: Tyler Higbee did not practice on Thursday.
news.head: Tyler Higbee (illness) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: Higbee was added to the injury report on Thursday due to an illness. He'll need to be monitored in practice on Friday.

news.body: Tyler Higbee caught one pass for 13 yards in Sunday’s win over the Commanders.
news.head: Tyler Higbee quiet again in win
news.impact: Week 9 marked Higbee's fourth straight game with less than 25 yards for the Rams, despite added opportunities due to fellow tight end Terrance Ferguson's injury. Despite four straight dud games, Higbee could be a TE2 in Week 10's game against the Cardinals if Puka Nacua (knee) and Ferguson (hamstring) are unable to play.

news.body: Tyler Higbee caught 1-of-2 targets for 14 yards in Sunday's 24-9 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Tyler Higbee underwhelming in loss Sunday
news.impact: Higbee wasn't able to get much going on Sunday, finishing with just one catch for 14 yards in a win over the Chargers. Fantasy managers shouldn't trust starting him on a weekly basis with how lacking his production has been over the past couple of weeks.

news.body: Tyler Warren caught four of his seven targets for 44 yards in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
news.head: Tyler Warren catches four balls in Week 9
news.impact: Warren finished second on the team in receiving and catches in the close loss to Dallas. The second-year tight end is putting together a quiet sophomore season, posting 38 catches for 275 yards and two touchdowns in seven games. He will settle in as a high-end TE2 in Week 10 vs. the Dolphins.

news.body: Tyler Warren managed to catch just 4-of-10 targets for only 18 yards in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Tyler Warren struggles in return from injury
news.impact: After missing each of the last two games due to a groin injury, Warren was back on the field for the Colts in Week 8. It didn't make much of a difference, however, as the second-year TE struggled in what was a terrible performance from the Colts on the whole. Warren's production should improve from here, but the Colts' offense is a difficult one to trust.

news.body: Tyler Warren will play on Sunday against the Jaguars.
news.head: Tyler Warren (groin) cleared to play Sunday
news.impact: Warren will return from a two-game absence. He remains a TE1 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Tyler Warren (groin) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Tyler Warren (groin) limited at practice again Thursday
news.impact: Warren has missed some time while recovering from a groin issue, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion for a second-straight day on Thursday. That's a good sign that he's trending the right way for Week 8, but we won't know his official injury status until later on in the week.

news.body: Adonai Mitchell is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Bills.
news.head: Adonai Mitchell (knee) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Mitchell was added to the injury report on Friday, but he was still able to log a full practice. He should be on the favorable side of questionable.

news.body: Adonai Mitchell did not record a reception on seven targets in a 35-12 loss to the Chiefs.
news.head: Adonai Mitchell held without a catch in Week 9
news.impact: Mitchell was second on the team in targets Sunday, but was the only pass catcher to not record a reception. This was a very disappointing result considering Mitchell had an excellent performance against Las Vegas last week. Mitchell and the Jets will look to bounce back against the Bills in Week 10.

news.body: Adonai Mitchell caught 7-of-9 targets for 142 yards and a touchdown in a 38-33 loss to the Raiders.
news.head: Adonai Mitchell finds the end zone in Week 8
news.impact: Mitchell turned in a career performance just one week after being blanked on the stat sheet. The 24-year-old found the end zone on a 12-yard reception in the second quarter and logged a team long 47-yard reception in the fourth quarter. Mitchell and the Jets will take on the Chiefs in Week 9.

news.body: Adonai Mitchell did not record a reception on three targets in a 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.
news.head: Adonai Mitchell held without a reception in Week 7
news.impact: Mitchell was held without a catch in his return from a finger injury. He was overshadowed by an excellent performance from Omar Cooper. Fantasy managers can leave Mitchell out of their lineups in Week 8.

news.body: A.J. Brown is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Lions.
news.head: A.J. Brown (ankle/knee) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Brown was limited in practice all week. He will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

news.body: A.J. Brown (ankle/knee) was officially limited at practice on Thursday.
news.head: A.J. Brown (ankle/knee) officially limited Thursday
news.impact: Brown was able to take part in practice again on Thursday, though he continues to be limited due to the pair of injuries that he's managing. He will have a real shot to suit up and play, so fantasy managers should keep very close tabs on all updates about his health over the next couple of days.

news.body: A.J. Brown was seen practicing on Thursday.
news.head: A.J. Brown (knee) practices Thursday
news.impact: Brown was officially limited in practice on Wednesday. He will need to be monitored on Thursday’s injury report.

news.body: A.J. Brown was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: A.J. Brown (knee) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: It is a positive sign for Brown to start the week after he traveled with the Patriots to Germany. His status will need to continue to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Patriots.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: St. Brown was limited in practice all week. He should be on the favorable side of questionable.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) limited again Thursday
news.impact: St. Brown was limited at a second-straight practice on Thursday. He's still managing a rib issue of some kind, but he played through it last week and seems likely to do the same again in Week 10. Fantasy managers shouldn't be concerned with his availability for Sunday's game unless he carries an injury designation heading into the weekend.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown hauled in eight of his team-leading 10 targets for 86 yards in the Lions' 19-9 Week 9 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown leads pass-catchers in Week 9 win over Dolphins
news.impact: St. Brown continues an impactful stretch in the Detroit passing attack, recording six or more receptions in seven of eight contests. The wideout remains locked in as a consistent WR1 option in all formats ahead of a Week 10 matchup against the New England Patriots.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) is active for Week 9 for the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) active for Week 9

news.body: Antonio Williams caught both of his targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.
news.head: Antonio Williams scores TD in Week 10 win
news.impact: Williams hauled in a 31-yard touchdown pass from Jayden Daniels in the third quarter. Unfortunately, he only drew two targets on a night when Daniels spread the ball around. Williams has shown explosive play-making potential in his rookie year, but he will need more targets to be fully trustworthy in fantasy leagues. Williams will be a boom/bust flex option in Week 11 vs. the Bengals.

news.body: Antonio Williams had three catches for 25 yards in Sunday’s loss to the Rams.
news.head: Antonio Williams has three catches in loss
news.impact: Williams has now put together his fifth straight game with at least three receptions. Williams has shown promising flashes of talent, and still has the chance to become the de-facto number one receiver in the Commanders' offense. He faces the Giants on Thursday Night Football where he will be in WR3/Flex range with high upside.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught five of his seven targets for 54 yards in a 27-10 win over the Eagles in Week 8.
news.head: Antonio Williams goes for 54 yards in Week 8
news.impact: Williams moved into a starting role with the Commanders playing their first game since losing Terry McLaurin to a season-ending knee injury. The rookie responded well, finishing second on the team in receiving yards while leading the way with seven targets. Williams becomes interesting in fantasy moving forward as he gears up to take on the Rams in Week 9.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught three of his four targets for 50 yards in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6.
news.head: Antonio Williams finishes with 50 receiving yards in Week 6
news.impact: Williams finished third on the team in receiving in the loss on Monday night. The rookie wideout has shown flashes this season but his role hasn't been large enough to be trusted as a weekly starter in fantasy. He could see more work after his bye in Week 7, after Terry McLaurin had to be carted off the field during Monday night's game against the 49ers. Williams is worth a waiver claim in most leagues this week.

news.body: Caleb Douglas hauled in six of his team-high eight targets for 70 yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 Week 9 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Caleb Douglas leads pass-catchers in Week 9 loss to Lions
news.impact: Douglas has been impactful despite inconsistent usage in the Miami offense of late, recording 70 receiving yards in two of his last three contests. The wideout offers fantasy managers one of the few reliable options in an underperforming Miami offense to this point, with a Week 10 contest against the Indianapolis Colts up next.

news.body: Caleb Douglas caught four of six targets for 43 yards in the Dolphins' 24-19 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.
news.head: Caleb Douglas comes down to earth in loss
news.impact: Douglas came back down to earth on Sunday, though a four for 43 yards is just fine in real life for a rookie. His efficiency had been insane, so it was bound to come down at some point. He's going to have a better matchup next week against the Lions and could be a flex play in that spot.

news.body: Caleb Douglas caught 2-of-3 targets for 70 yards and two touchdowns in a 28-25 win over the Jets.
news.head: Caleb Douglas finds the end zone twice in Week 7
news.impact: Douglas found the end zone on a seven yard reception and a 63-yard reception to help pace the Dolphins to their first win of the season. This marked the first game Douglas has played in since suffering an injury in Week 2, and he provided an immediate jolt in the Dolphins' passing attack. Douglas will look to build on this performance against the Patriots in Week 8.

news.body: Dolphins WR Caleb Douglas (ankle) is officially active for Week 7 matchup with the Jets.
news.head: Caleb Douglas (ankle) officially active for Week 7
news.impact: Douglas has been out of action since Week 2. Prior to his injury, he had seven receptions for 113 yards in his first two NFL games. Fantasy managers should expect him to be involved in the Dolphins' passing attack.

news.body: Carnell Tate has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
news.head: Carnell Tate (shoulder) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Tate will remain sidelined out of the bye week for Tennessee. Wan'Dale Robinson will remain in a bigger role in his place.

news.body: Carnell Tate (shoulder) missed another practice session on Thursday.
news.head: Carnell Tate (shoulder) misses another practice Thursday
news.impact: The rookie wasn't able to practice again on Thursday as he continues to recover from a shoulder injury. It looks like he's trending towards being sidelined again in Week 10, which would likely lead to more work for Wan'Dale Robinson this week.

news.body: Carnell Tate did not practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Carnell Tate (shoulder) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: Tate still isn't able to practice coming off the Titans bye week. He will need to continue to be monitored the rest of the week in practice.

news.body: Carnell Tate has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bengals.
news.head: Carnell Tate (shoulder) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Tate was unable to practice all week. Wan’Dale Robinson will be in the WR3/flex conversation even more so this week.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb caught 10 of his 16 targets for 195 yards and a touchdown in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb goes for 195 yards, TD in Week 9
news.impact: Lamb lost a fumble early in the fourth quarter after making a spectacular catch for a 48-yard gain, the only blemish in an otherwise exceptional performance. The veteran wideout continues to post big numbers for the Cowboys, catching 70 balls for 904 yards and seven touchdowns through nine games. He will be a locked-in WR1 in Week 10 vs. the 49ers.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb hauled in seven of his team-high 11 targets for 58 yards in the Cowboys' 33-30 Week 8 loss to the Cardinals.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb leads pass-catchers in Week 8 loss to Cardinals
news.impact: Lamb was held mostly in check Sunday, finishing under 60 receiving yards for the first time in his last three contests. The wideout remains locked in as an elite WR1 option against a generous Indianapolis Colts defense in Week 9.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb hauled in 5-of-12 targets for 74 yards and two touchdowns in Monday night's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb hauls in two touchdowns Monday
news.impact: Lamb wasn't able to connect with Prescott on over half of his targets, but he was able to make the most out of the ones that he did catch, finishing with 74 yards and two touchdowns in a comfortable win over the Eagles. He will continue to be a top-tier fantasy option moving forward, assuming he remains healthy.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb caught nine of his 18 targets for 70 yards in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb goes for 70 yards in Week 6
news.impact: Lamb drew an impressive number of targets but was inefficient with the workload, catching just half of them while averaging just 7.8 yards per catch. The veteran wideout now has 48 catches for 577 yards and four touchdowns through six games. He will be a high-end WR1 in fantasy in Week 7 vs. the Eagles.

news.body: Chris Olave caught 7 of 12 targets for 98 yards in the Saints' 23-22 overtime win over the Browns on Sunday.
news.head: Chris Olave sees 12 targets in win over Browns
news.impact: Olave was hard at work in this one, more than doubling up the next closest Saint in targets, which was rookie Jordyn Tyson. He also nearly doubled up the next closest Saint in yardage and had three more receptions than any other. It was his best yardage total in a month, and he will look to keep things up against the Panthers next week.

news.body: Chris Olave caught six of ten targets for 56 yards in the Saints' 16-10 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.
news.head: Chris Olave snags 6 passes in loss
news.impact: Olave was second on the team in receiving yards by one, but led in targets by three over RB Alvin Kamara. It wasn't the game we would have hoped for Olave, but it certainly wasn't something that ruined your week. He's been quiet over the last three weeks, aside from a touchdown last Sunday. He will look to have better results against Cleveland after the Saints' bye.

news.body: Chris Olave caught 4-of-7 targets for 43 yards and a touchdown in the Saints 34-27 win over the Giants.
news.head: Chris Olave hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: It wasn't a huge day for Olave, but he made up for it with a touchdown. He will remain a WR1 heading into next week against the Steelers.

news.body: Saints WR Chris Olave (illness) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with the Giants.
news.head: Chris Olave (illness) officially active for Week 6
news.impact: Olave was able to practice Friday but was listed as questionable to play as a precaution. The Saints will have their top pass catcher active against the Giants.

news.body: Christian Watson hauled in seven of his eight targets for 171 yards and one touchdown in the Packers' 45-27 Week 9 win over the Patriots.
news.head: Christian Watson finds end zone in Week 9 win over Patriots
news.impact: Watson has been impactful in the Green Bay offense of late, recording over 115 receiving yards in three of his last five games. The wideout remains one of the few dynamic offensive options in the Green Bay offense to this point, with a Week 10 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings up next.

news.body: Christian Watson (rib) is good to go for Sunday's game against the New England Patriots.
news.head: Christian Watson (rib) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Watson suffered a broken rib last week, but it's not going to prevent him from playing this week and he is officially good to go for Sunday's game. Fantasy managers should feel confident starting him this week in what projects to be a high-scoring affair in New England this weekend.

news.body: Christian Watson remained limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Christian Watson (rib) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Watson is continuing to trend towards being good to go for Sunday's game against the Patriots.

news.body: Christian Watson (rib) was limited at Green Bay's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Christian Watson (rib) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: Watson suffered a rib injury in Green Bay's win over the Panthers last week, which left him limited at the team's practice on Wednesday. It looks like he's on track to be a full go for Week 9, but we won't know his official status until later on in the week.

news.body: Rams head coach Sean McVay told reporters that WR Davante Adams ruptured his hamstring and now will be sidelined 6-10 weeks.
news.head: Davante Adams to miss 6-10 weeks with ruptured hamstring
news.impact: It is another brutal injury for the Rams and for fantasy managers. They'll likely continue to involve the tight ends even more in the passing game.

news.body: Davante Adams caught 3-of-4 targets for 39 yards before leaving Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals early with a leg injury of some kind.
news.head: Davante Adams suffers leg injury in loss Sunday
news.impact: Adams wasn't having a good game late on Sunday, and things got worse when he suffered a lower-body injury of some kind late in the game. Los Angeles wasn't able to pick up the win, and fantasy managers should keep very close tabs on all updates about his health throughout the week.

news.body: Davante Adams caught five of his seven targets for 51 yards and two touchdowns in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.head: Davante Adams brings in two TD passes in Week 5
news.impact: Adams found the end zone twice in the high-scoring loss on Monday night. He kicked off the scoring for LA with a four-yard grab in the second quarter and later came back to add a five-yard catch for a score.
