news.impact: McMillan caught a four-yard touchdown with just over three minutes remaining to pull Carolina within five points. He finished second on the Panthers in receiving yards behind Darren Waller, who saw 10 targets compared to McMillan's six. The touchdown helped, but Waller commanded more opportunities against Denver. McMillan remains a starting option in fantasy leagues heading into Week 10.

news.body: Tetairoa McMillan brought down 6-of-11 targets for 58 yards in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
news.head: Tetairoa McMillan catches six passes in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Fantasy managers in PPR formats were certainly okay with McMillan's performance in this one. The volume was there, but the Packers did a great job of limiting the second-year star's yardage. McMillan has now caught 30 passes over his last four games and is averaging exactly six per contest for the season. However, he scored both of his touchdowns in Week 4 against the Lions. He remains a high-end WR2 in most formats.

news.body: Tetairoa McMillan caught four of six targets for 40 yards in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to Tampa Bay on Sunday.
news.head: Tetairoa McMillan catches four passes in loss
news.impact: McMillan was largely held in check all day by the Tampa defense, as was the rest of the Carolina offense. It wasn't a great showing by the young receiver, but it didn't sink your week. He will look to improve on those numbers against the Packers on TNF.

news.body: Carolina Panthers wide receiver Tetairoa McMillan caught six passes for 86 yards in a Week 6 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Tetairoa McMillan gains 86 yards in Week 6 win
news.impact: McMillan has 75+ yards and 8+ targets in four of five games to start the season, a reliable floor in what has been a potent Carolina passing offense. He has not caught a touchdown yet with wide receiver Jalen Coker in the lineup, but McMillan's large frame and target rate indicate more could come in the future after scoring seven as a rookie.

news.body: Tre Tucker caught 4-of-8 targets for 55 yards in the Raiders 38-17 loss against the 49ers.
news.head: Tre Tucker totals 55 yards Sunday
news.impact: The eight targets Tucker saw tied the team-high. He will remain a volatile WR3 heading into next week against the Seahawks.

news.body: Tre Tucker did not record a reception on his lone target in a 38-33 win over the Jets.
news.head: Tre Tucker held without a catch in Week 8 win
news.impact: Tucker's one target marks a new season low for the 25-year-old. Jalen Nailor was the only wide receiver on the roster that logged a catch in the high-scoring affair with the Jets. Tucker and the Raiders will take on the 49ers in Week 9.

news.body: Tre Tucker hauled in five of his team-high 12 targets for 103 yards and one touchdown in the Raiders' 35-21 Week 7 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Tre Tucker leads pass-catchers in Week 7 loss to Rams
news.impact: Tucker has been dynamic in the Las Vegas passing attack of late, recording over 90 receiving yards and at least one touchdown in each of the last two contests. The wideout offers head coach Klint Kubiak one of the more impactful options in the Las Vegas passing attack to this point, with a Week 8 matchup against the New York Jets up next.

news.body: Tre Tucker caught 5-of-7 targets for 97 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Tre Tucker stellar in loss Sunday
news.impact: Tucker had a stellar performance on Sunday. He led the team with 97 yards over the course of the afternoon and he was also able to get into the end zone on two occasions, which left him with a great fantasy total on the day. Fantasy managers should consider picking him up if he's available on the waiver wire, as the team may very well try to get him more involved on a week-to-week basis after this game.

news.body: Wan'Dale Robinson caught six of his seven targets for 57 yards and a touchdown in a 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals in Week 8.
news.head: Wan'Dale Robinson catches TD in Week 8
news.impact: Robinson hauled in a 15-yard touchdown pass from Cam Ward in the fourth quarter to give the Titans a brief lead. The veteran wideout has caught 35 passes for 262 yards and three touchdowns through eight games. A solid WR4 in PPR fantasy leagues, he will be on his bye in Week 9.

news.body: Wan'Dale Robinson caught four of his six targets for seven yards in a 27-24 loss to the Browns in Week 7.
news.head: Wan'Dale Robinson held to seven yards in Week 7
news.impact: Robinson was held to just 1.8 yards per carry by a tough Cleveland secondary. The veteran wideout has topped 50 receiving yards just twice in seven contests this season. Robinson will be a WR4 in fantasy heading into Week 8 against the Bengals.

news.body: Wan'Dale Robinson caught three of seven targets for 22 yards in the Titans' 26-20 win over the Colts on Sunday.
news.head: Wan'Dale Robinson snags three passes in win
news.impact: Robinson and Carnell Tate were the only pass catchers to catch more than one pass from Cam Ward on Sunday, and also the only two to go over 10 yards. Robinson has had some usable performances this year, but they seem to come on an every-other-week basis.

news.body: Wan'Dale Robinson caught 6-of-7 targets for 53 yards in the Titans 26-3 loss against the Texans on Sunday.
news.head: Wan'Dale Robinson leads Titans in receiving Sunday
news.impact: Robinson posted his third game with 50 yards on the season. He remains a WR3/ flex play next week against the Colts.

news.body: Xavier Hutchinson caught 3-of-5 targets for 29 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 44-22 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Xavier Hutchinson scores once in win Sunday
news.impact: Hutchinson was able to contribute for the Texans on Sunday, scoring a touchdown on one of his three catches in a win over the Chargers. Fantasy managers should not have high hopes for him moving forward, however.

news.body: Xavier Hutchinson caught 3-of-6 targets for 17 yards and a touchdown in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
news.head: Xavier Hutchinson hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Hutchinson hauled in one of the two touchdowns thrown by C.J. Stroud on the day. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Xavier Hutchinson caught 2-of-3 targets for 10 yards in a 34-31 win over Jacksonville.
news.head: Xavier Hutchinson held to two receptions in Week 6
news.impact: Hutchinson logged his lowest receiving totals of the season in the win Sunday. With the addition of Marvin Harrison Jr. to the roster, Hutchinson's role will be limited and he should be left off fantasy rosters for now.

news.body: Xavier Hutchinson caught 4-of-5 targets for 65 yards in the Texans 26-3 win over the Titans.
news.head: Xavier Hutchinson totals team-high 65 yards Sunday
news.impact: Hutchinson led Houston in receiving on the afternoon. He still remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: Zay Flowers caught three of six targets for 6 yards and ran three times for 17 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday.
news.head: Zay Flowers manages 23 yards in loss to Jags
news.impact: Flowers had three more catches than he had on Sunday, but it didn't amount to much. Jacoby Brissett should bring back some life to the fantasy value of Flowers once he takes the reins of the offense, and thankfully that should come next week.

news.body: Zay Flowers did not record a reception on five targets in a 36-10 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Zay Flowers held without a catch in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Flowers and the rest of the Ravens' receivers struggled with both Lamar Jackson (thumb) and Tyler Huntley (toe) exiting the game with injuries. Jackson is expected to be placed on IR and Huntley's status is uncertain for Week 9. If Huntley is unable to play, Flowers and the rest of the Ravens' pass catchers should be downgraded in a matchup with Jacksonville.

news.body: Zay Flowers caught 8-of-11 targets for 137 yards and a touchdown in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals.
news.head: Zay Flowers excellent in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Flowers opened the scoring on a 48-yard touchdown in the first quarter. Flowers led the team in all receiving categories, and he will look to do the same in Week 8 against the Bills.

news.body: Baltimore Ravens wide receiver Zay Flowers caught six passes for 66 yards on a season-high 11 targets in Week 6 against the Cleveland Browns.
news.head: Zay Flowers logs season-high 11 targets in Week 6
news.impact: Flowers' weekly floor has been impressive this season, recording at least 50 yards in every contest this season. It was his second game with double-digit targets in a concentrated passing attack that has been successful this season. When Lamar Jackson returns, Flowers has a higher ceiling, having failed to reach the end zone in the last two weeks.
